function stageStates(record: any, mode: 'operating' | 'rehearsal' = 'operating') {
  const legacy = record.manifest.phase === 'predecessor'
    ? predecessorLegacyStages(record)
    : featureLegacyStages(record);
  const targetRoots = record.manifest.operatingIdentity.targetStageRoots;
  const prefixRoot = mode === 'operating'
    ? record.manifest.operatingIdentity.prefixIdentityRoot
    : sha256(`fixture-prefix-${record.manifest.phase}`);
  const baseRoot = mode === 'operating'
    ? record.manifest.baseMapping.baseIdentityRoot
    : sha256(`fixture-base-${record.manifest.phase}`);
  const predecessorFullRoot = ledgerIdentityRoot(record.predecessorRows);
  return legacy.map((legacyStage: any, index: number) => ({
    bundle: {
      ledgerCount: record.manifest.operatingTransition.before + index,
      prefixRoot,
      priorCount: record.manifest.operatingTransition.before,
      suffixRoot: legacyStage.bundle.suffixRoot,
      targetCount: index,
    },
    state: {
      baseIdentityRoot: baseRoot,
      baseRowCount: 86,
      evidenceCount: 3,
      evidenceIdentityRoot: record.manifest.operatingIdentity.evidenceIdentityRoot,
      evidenceReady: true,
      featureCount: record.manifest.phase === 'feature' ? index : 0,
      featureIdentityRoot: record.manifest.phase === 'feature' ? targetRoots[index] : emptyRoot,
      featureReady: record.manifest.phase === 'feature' ? index === 5 : false,
      historicalAppliedVariantReady: mode === 'operating',
      ledgerIdentityRoot: mode === 'operating'
        ? record.manifest.operatingIdentity.ledgerStageRoots[index]
        : sha256(`fixture-ledger-${record.manifest.phase}-${index}`),
      legacyBundle: legacyStage.bundle,
      legacyState: legacyStage.state,
      operatingBaseReady: mode === 'operating',
      predecessorCount: record.manifest.phase === 'predecessor' ? index : 11,
      predecessorIdentityRoot: record.manifest.phase === 'predecessor'
        ? targetRoots[index]
        : predecessorFullRoot,
      predecessorReady: record.manifest.phase === 'predecessor' ? index === 11 : true,
      targetIdentityRoot: targetRoots[index],
      targetStageIndex: index,
    },
  }));
}

test('loads separately held 89->100 and 100->105 contracts', () => {
  const predecessor = loadEvidencePrefixedSuccessorManifest('predecessor');
  const feature = loadEvidencePrefixedSuccessorManifest('feature');

  expect(predecessor.manifest.operatingTransition).toEqual({ before: 89, after: 100 });
  expect(feature.manifest.operatingTransition).toEqual({ before: 100, after: 105 });
  expect(predecessor.targetRows).toHaveLength(11);
  expect(feature.targetRows).toHaveLength(5);
  expect(predecessor.evidenceRows).toHaveLength(3);
  expect(predecessor.manifest.baseMapping.baseIdentityRoot)
    .toBe(feature.manifest.baseMapping.baseIdentityRoot);
  expect(() => assertEvidencePrefixedLaunchReady(predecessor))
    .toThrow('EVIDENCE_PREFIXED_PREDECESSOR_LAUNCH_HELD');
  expect(() => assertEvidencePrefixedLaunchReady(feature))
    .toThrow('EVIDENCE_PREFIXED_FEATURE_LAUNCH_HELD');
});

test('compiles local aggregate SQL against rehearsal identity without reusing hosted roots', () => {

  }
});

    kind: 'review-media-successor-operator-custody-attestation',
    noticeState: 'not-issued',
    operatorRole: 'repository-owner',
    repository: 'twoimo/tzudong',
    runAttempt: '1',
    runId: '987654321',
    schemaVersion: 1,
    scope: 'stopped-until-application-result',
    sourceRevision,
    workflowRef: 'twoimo/tzudong/.github/workflows/review-media-sql-successor.yml@refs/heads/main',
  };
  const bundle = {
    adminRecordMutationsHold: {
      commit: sourceRevision,
      deploymentId: 'dpl_FeatureSuccessorFixture123',
      holdActive: true,
      observedAt,
    },
    createdAt,
    expiresAt,
    kind: 'review-media-successor-vercel-operating-bundle',
    manifestSha256: predecessorRecord.manifestSha256,
    protectedMain: {},
    rollbackPolicy: {},
    rollbackReadback: {
      deploymentId: 'dpl_FeatureSuccessorFixture123',
      gitSha: rollbackRevision,
    },
    schemaVersion: 1,
    sourceRevision,
    sourceRoot: predecessor.sourceRoot,
    storyboardPolicy: {
      deployment: {
        branch: 'main',
        deploymentId: 'dpl_FeatureSuccessorFixture123',
        sourceCommit: sourceRevision,
      },
      policy: { canonicalPolicySha256: 'c'.repeat(64) },
      schemaVersion: 1,
    },
  };
  const machine = {
    adminRuntimeHold: {
      deploymentId: 'dpl_FeatureSuccessorFixture123',
      holdActive: true,
      observedAt,
    },
    automaticReviewer: { observedAt: freshObservedAt, state: 'stopped' },
    g037WriteFreeze: { observedAt: freshObservedAt, state: 'active' },
    inFlightQuiescence: {
      coverage,
      inFlightWriters: 0,
      lockMode: 'SHARE',
      observedAt: freshObservedAt,
    },
    kind: 'review-media-successor-machine-operating-observations',
    schemaVersion: 1,
    sourceRevision,
  };
  const common = {
    expiresAt,
    id: predecessor.id,
    manifestSha256: predecessorRecord.manifestSha256,
    projectRef: predecessor.projectRef,
    purpose: predecessor.purpose,
    schemaVersion: 1,
    sourceRevision,
  };
  const quiescence = {
    ...common,
    coverage,
    inFlightWriters: 0,
    kind: 'apply-in-flight-quiescence-readback',
    lockMode: 'SHARE',
    observedAt: freshObservedAt,
  };
  const records = {
    attestation: { name: 'operator-custody-attestation.json', value: attestation },
    bundle: { name: 'vercel-operating-bundle.json', value: bundle },
    machine: { name: 'apply-machine-operating-observations.json', value: machine },
    quiescence: { name: 'apply-quiescence-readback.json', value: quiescence },
  };
  for (const record of Object.values(records)) writeCanonical(join(custody, record.name), record.value);
  const hashes = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(records).map(([key, record]) => [
    key,
    sha256(readFileSync(join(custody, record.name))),
  ]));
  const receiptProvenance: Record<string, any> = {};
  for (const [fence, state] of Object.entries(predecessor.requiredWriterFences)) {
    const operator = ['browserRpc', 'dashboard', 'directSql', 'providerIngress'].includes(fence);
    const receipt = {
      ...common,
      fence,
      kind: 'writer-fence-readback-receipt',
      observedAt: ['automaticReviewer', 'g037WriteFreeze'].includes(fence)
        ? freshObservedAt
        : fence === 'adminRecordMutationsHold'
          ? bundle.adminRecordMutationsHold.observedAt
          : attestation.assertedAt,
      state,
    };
    const name = `apply-writer-fence-${fence}.json`;
    writeCanonical(join(custody, name), receipt);
    receiptProvenance[fence] = {
      evidenceSha256: operator
        ? hashes.attestation
        : fence === 'adminRecordMutationsHold' ? hashes.bundle : hashes.machine,
      provenance: operator
        ? 'authenticated-owner-custody-commitment'
        : fence === 'adminRecordMutationsHold'
          ? 'immutable-deployment-machine-observation'
          : 'fresh-machine-observation',
      receiptSha256: sha256(readFileSync(join(custody, name))),
    };
  }
  const map = {
    attestationSha256: hashes.attestation,
    bundleSha256: hashes.bundle,
    kind: 'review-media-successor-apply-operating-evidence-map',
    machineSha256: hashes.machine,
    quiescenceSha256: hashes.quiescence,
    receiptProvenance,
    schemaVersion: 1,
    sourceRevision,
  };
  const mapPath = join(custody, 'apply-operating-evidence-map.json');
  writeCanonical(mapPath, map);
  return {
    applyEvidenceMapSha256: sha256(readFileSync(mapPath)),
    applyQuiescenceReadbackSha256: hashes.quiescence,
  };
}

function createCommittedPredecessor(rollbackRevision = sourceRevision) {
  const root = privateRoot();
  const inputPath = join(root, 'operating-input.json');
  const custodyDirectory = join(root, 'custody');
  writeCanonical(inputPath, operatingInput(rollbackRevision));
  prepareReviewMediaRehearsalAdmission({
    custodyDirectory,
    inputPath,
    manifestRecord: predecessorRecord,
    now: new Date('2026-10-14T01:00:06.000Z'),
  });
  const published = publishPredecessorRehearsal(custodyDirectory);
  const applyEvidence = publishPredecessorApplyEvidence(custodyDirectory, rollbackRevision);
  const applyInputPath = join(root, 'apply-input.json');
  writeCanonical(applyInputPath, {
    ...applyEvidence,
    attemptId: '123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174201',
    expiresAt,
    kind: 'review-media-successor-apply-admission-input',
    manifestSha256: predecessorRecord.manifestSha256,
    observedAt: '2026-10-14T01:00:12.000Z',
    rehearsalAdmissionSha256: published.admissionSha256,
    rehearsalJournalSha256: published.journalSha256,
    rehearsalReceiptSha256: published.receiptSha256,
    schemaVersion: 1,
    sourceRevision,
  });
  const apply = prepareReviewMediaApplyAdmission({
    custodyDirectory,
    inputPath: applyInputPath,
    manifestRecord: predecessorRecord,
    now: new Date('2026-10-14T01:00:12.000Z'),
  });
  const admissionBytes = readFileSync(apply.admissionPath);
  const admission = JSON.parse(admissionBytes.toString('utf8'));
  const journal = [
    {
      admissionSha256: sha256(admissionBytes),
      attemptId: admission.attemptId,
      event: 'started',
      manifestSha256: admission.manifestSha256,
      sourceRevision,
      sourceRoot: admission.sourceRoot,
      startedAt: '2026-10-14T01:00:20.000Z',
    },
    {
      attemptId: admission.attemptId,
      code: 'SUCCESSOR_COMMITTED',
      completedAt: '2026-10-14T01:00:25.000Z',
      event: 'terminal',
    },
  ];
  writeFileSync(apply.journalPath, Buffer.from(`${journal.map(entry => JSON.stringify(canonical(entry))).join('\n')}\n`), { mode: 0o600 });
  chmodSync(apply.journalPath, 0o600);
  return { custodyDirectory, root };
}

function featureStageStates() {
  const prefixRoot = '8'.repeat(64);
  const roleRoot = sha256('feature-role-root');
  const g014Before = sha256('feature-g014-before');
  const g014After = sha256('feature-g014-after');
  const storageBefore = sha256('feature-storage-before');
  const storageAfter = sha256('feature-storage-after');
  const storyboardBefore = sha256('feature-storyboard-before');
  const storyboardAfter = sha256('feature-storyboard-after');
  return Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, index) => ({
    bundle: {
      ledgerCount: 97 + index,
      prefixRoot,
      priorCount: 97,
      suffixRoot: index === 5 ? fiveMigrationBundleSuffixRoot(featureManifest.migrations) : null,
      targetCount: index,
    },
    state: {
      activeReviewItems: 0,
      baseReviewReady: true,
      catalogRoot: sha256(`feature-catalog-${index}`),
      currentUser: 'postgres',
      databaseName: 'postgres',
      featureRuntimeReady: index >= 5,
      g014Ready: index >= 3,
      g014Root: index < 3 ? g014Before : g014After,
      immutableReady: index >= 4,
      ledgerRoot: index === 0 ? prefixRoot : sha256(`feature-ledger-${index}`),
      ocrReady: index >= 2,
      predecessorReady: true,
      reviewPolicyEnabled: false,
      reviewRuns: 0,
      roleRoot,
      runtimePredicateReady: index >= 5,
      serverMajor: 17,
      sessionUser: 'postgres',
      storageRoot: index < 4 ? storageBefore : storageAfter,
      storyboardReady: index >= 1,
      storyboardRoot: index === 0 ? storyboardBefore : storyboardAfter,
    },
  }));
}

  return {
    deploymentId: 'dpl_FeatureSuccessorFixture123',
    deploymentUrl: 'https://tzudong-feature-successor-fixture.vercel.app/',
    gitRef: 'main',
    gitSha: sourceRevision,
    kind: 'vercel-rollback-readback',
    observedAt: '2026-10-14T01:00:30.000Z',
    productionAliases: ['tzudong.app', 'www.tzudong.app'],
    projectId: 'prj_sau35J5uUtShIQ9OKofRtOVVnTSl',
    readyState: 'READY',
    repository: 'twoimo/tzudong',
    schemaVersion: 1,
    target: 'production',
    teamId: 'team_OUj64KeLxJI3PkEbOaFZnorA',
  };
}

function publishFeatureRehearsal(custody: string) {
  const admissionPath = join(custody, FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_FILES.rehearsalAdmission);
  const admissionBytes = readFileSync(admissionPath);
  const admission = JSON.parse(admissionBytes.toString('utf8'));
  const admissionSha256 = sha256(admissionBytes);
  const stages = featureStageStates();
  const receipt = {
    admissionSha256,
    attemptId: admission.attemptId,
    expiresAt,
    id: featureManifest.id,
    kind: 'feature-successor-rehearsal-receipt',
    manifestSha256: featureRecord.manifestSha256,
    observedAt: '2026-10-14T01:00:32.000Z',
    passed: true,
    preflightStateSha256: sha256(JSON.stringify(canonical(stages[0]))),
    projectRef: featureManifest.projectRef,
    purpose: featureManifest.purpose,
    restoredStateSha256: sha256(JSON.stringify(canonical(stages[0]))),
    schemaVersion: 1,
    serverVersionNum: 170006,
    sourceRevision,
    sourceRoot: featureManifest.sourceRoot,
    stageStates: stages,
    stageStatesSha256: sha256(JSON.stringify(canonical(stages))),
    suffixRoot: fiveMigrationBundleSuffixRoot(featureManifest.migrations),
  };
  const receiptBytes = canonicalBytes(receipt);
  const receiptSha256 = sha256(receiptBytes);
  const journal = [
    {
      admissionSha256,
      attemptId: admission.attemptId,
      event: 'started',
      manifestSha256: featureRecord.manifestSha256,
      sourceRevision,
      sourceRoot: featureManifest.sourceRoot,
      startedAt: '2026-10-14T01:00:30.000Z',
    },
    {
      attemptId: admission.attemptId,
      code: 'FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_REHEARSAL_PASSED',
      completedAt: '2026-10-14T01:00:33.000Z',
      event: 'terminal',
      receiptSha256,
    },
  ];
  writeFileSync(join(custody, FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_FILES.rehearsalReceipt), receiptBytes, { mode: 0o600 });
  writeFileSync(
    join(custody, FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_FILES.rehearsalJournal),
    Buffer.from(`${journal.map(entry => JSON.stringify(canonical(entry))).join('\n')}\n`),
    { mode: 0o600 },
  );
  chmodSync(join(custody, FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_FILES.rehearsalReceipt), 0o600);
  chmodSync(join(custody, FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_FILES.rehearsalJournal), 0o600);
}

test('state contract binds G014, Storage, roles, catalog and cumulative feature readiness', () => {
  const query = buildFeatureSuccessorStateQuery(featureRecord);
  for (const token of [
    "'catalogRoot'", "'g014Root'", "'storageRoot'", "'roleRoot'",
    "'storyboardReady'", "'ocrReady'", "'g014Ready'", "'immutableReady'", "'runtimePredicateReady'", "'featureRuntimeReady'",
    'pg_auth_members', 'g014_public_rpc_allowlist', "polrelid='storage.objects'::regclass",
    "a.attrelid='public.reviews'::regclass", 'a.atttypmod = -1', "a.attidentity = ''", "a.attgenerated = ''",
    "WHEN 'idx_reviews_receipt_hash'", "pg_get_indexdef(c.oid,1,true)='receipt_hash'",
    "WHEN 'reviews_ocr_pending_idx'", "WHEN 'reviews_duplicate_idx'", "am.amname='btree'",
    'i.indisvalid AND i.indisready AND i.indislive',
    "t.tgname='a01_review_verification_guard_delete'", "t.tgenabled='O'", 'pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,false)',
    '24311fc7071597fbc78c4c54897690da5aaa70edb62c24f7912fd23fecf515b0',
    "p.proowner='postgres'::regrole", "p.proconfig=ARRAY['search_path=\"\"']::text[]",
    "p.provolatile='s'", "p.prorettype='jsonb'::regtype",
    'public.create_review_with_receipt_ocr(uuid,uuid,uuid,text,text,timestamptz,text,text[],text[],uuid,uuid,uuid,text,timestamptz,text,jsonb)',
    '7160f72a9a7a18bb235f65bbf7db8bbbec1fe984a363d1a96f3a61cd6540ee7f',
    "has_function_privilege('privacy_workflow_owner',p.oid,'EXECUTE')",
  ]) expect(query).toContain(token);
  const stages = featureStageStates();
  expect(validateFeatureStageStates(stages, featureManifest)).toEqual({
    prefixRoot: '8'.repeat(64),
    priorCount: 97,
    suffixRoot: fiveMigrationBundleSuffixRoot(featureManifest.migrations),
  });
  const reusedAtLedger105 = structuredClone(stages);
  reusedAtLedger105[5].bundle.ledgerCount = 105;
  reusedAtLedger105[5].bundle.priorCount = 100;
  expect(() => validateFeatureStageStates(reusedAtLedger105, featureManifest))
    .toThrow('FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_ADMISSION_INVALID');
  const roleDrift = structuredClone(stages);
  roleDrift[3].state.roleRoot = sha256('drift');
  expect(() => validateFeatureStageStates(roleDrift, featureManifest))
    .toThrow('FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_ADMISSION_INVALID');
  const storageTooEarly = structuredClone(stages);
  storageTooEarly[2].state.storageRoot = sha256('early-storage-drift');
  expect(() => validateFeatureStageStates(storageTooEarly, featureManifest))
    .toThrow('FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_ADMISSION_INVALID');
  const falseG014 = structuredClone(stages);
  falseG014[3].state.g014Ready = false;
  expect(() => validateFeatureStageStates(falseG014, featureManifest))
    .toThrow('FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_ADMISSION_INVALID');
  const readyBeforeRuntimePredicate = structuredClone(stages);
  readyBeforeRuntimePredicate[4].state.featureRuntimeReady = true;
  expect(() => validateFeatureStageStates(readyBeforeRuntimePredicate, featureManifest))
    .toThrow('FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_ADMISSION_INVALID');
});

test('five-stage rehearsal and apply plans preserve source order, rollback, and expiry guards', () => {
  const stages = featureStageStates();
  const admission = { expiresAt, stageStates: stages } as any;
  const rehearsal = compileFeatureRehearsalPlan(featureRecord, admission, stages[0]);
  expect(rehearsal.transactionMode).toBe('explicit-rollback-only');
  expect(rehearsal.sql.match(/feature-successor-rehearsal-stage/g)).toHaveLength(6);
  expect(rehearsal.sql).toContain('ROLLBACK;');
  for (const migration of featureManifest.migrations) {
    expect(rehearsal.sql).toContain(
      `INSERT INTO supabase_migrations.schema_migrations(version,name,statements) VALUES('${migration.version}','${migration.name}'`,
    );
  }
  const apply = compileFeatureApplyPlan(featureRecord, admission);
  expect(apply.plans).toHaveLength(5);
  expect(apply.priorCount).toBe(97);
  expect(apply.sql).toContain(FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_PRE_COMMIT_EXPIRY_MARKER);
  expect(apply.sql).toContain('pg_advisory_xact_lock(7311754282260212::bigint)');
  expect(apply.transactionMode).toBe('single-outer-transaction');
});

test('feature admission reuses committed parent fences and window without creating receipts', () => {
  const { custodyDirectory } = createCommittedPredecessor();
  const before = new Set(readdirSync(custodyDirectory));
  const prepared = prepareFeatureRehearsalAdmission({
    custodyDirectory,
    loadManifestImpl: () => featureRecord,
    now: fixedNow,
  });
  const after = new Set(readdirSync(custodyDirectory));
  expect([...after].filter(name => !before.has(name))).toEqual([
    FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_FILES.rehearsalAdmission,
  ]);
  const admission = JSON.parse(readFileSync(prepared.admissionPath, 'utf8'));
  const parent = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(custodyDirectory, FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_FILES.baseAdmission), 'utf8'));
  expect(admission).toMatchObject({
    baseAdmissionSha256: sha256(readFileSync(join(
      custodyDirectory,
      FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_FILES.baseAdmission,
    ))),
    baseApplyEvidenceMapSha256: parent.applyEvidenceMapSha256,
    baseApplyQuiescenceReadbackSha256: parent.applyQuiescenceReadbackSha256,
    baseRehearsalAdmissionSha256: parent.rehearsalAdmissionSha256,
    createdAt,
    expiresAt,
    kind: 'feature-successor-rehearsal-admission',
    sourceRevision,
    writerFences: parent.writerFences,
  });
  expect(parent.applyEvidenceMapSha256).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
  expect(parent.applyQuiescenceReadbackSha256).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
  expect(parent.rehearsalAdmissionSha256).toBe(sha256(readFileSync(join(
    custodyDirectory,
    'rehearsal-admission.json',
  ))));
  expect(admission.rollback.deploymentSha).toBe(sourceRevision);
  expect([...after].filter(name => name.startsWith('writer-fence-')))
    .toEqual([...before].filter(name => name.startsWith('writer-fence-')));

  publishFeatureRehearsal(custodyDirectory);
  const apply = prepareFeatureApplyAdmission({
    custodyDirectory,
    loadManifestImpl: () => featureRecord,
    now: fixedNow,
  });
  const applyAdmission = JSON.parse(readFileSync(apply.admissionPath, 'utf8'));
  expect(applyAdmission.stageStates).toEqual(featureStageStates());
  expect(applyAdmission.expiresAt).toBe(expiresAt);
  expect(applyAdmission).toMatchObject({
    baseApplyEvidenceMapSha256: parent.applyEvidenceMapSha256,
    baseApplyQuiescenceReadbackSha256: parent.applyQuiescenceReadbackSha256,
    baseRehearsalAdmissionSha256: parent.rehearsalAdmissionSha256,
  });
});

test('rehearsal records a bounded terminal failure when rollback restoration differs', () => {
  const { custodyDirectory } = createCommittedPredecessor();
  prepareFeatureRehearsalAdmission({
    custodyDirectory,
    loadManifestImpl: () => featureRecord,
    now: fixedNow,
  });
  const stages = featureStageStates();
  const changedRestore = structuredClone(stages[0]);
  changedRestore.state.reviewRuns = 1;
  let call = 0;
  expect(() => runFeatureSuccessorRehearsal({
    custodyDirectory,
    environment: { SUPABASE_DB_URL: databaseUrl },
  }, {
    clock: () => fixedNow,
    gitFactsImpl: () => ({ clean: true, detached: true, revision: sourceRevision }),
    loadManifestImpl: () => featureRecord,
    protectedMainReadbackImpl: () => protectedSourceReadbackBinding(featureManifest, sourceRevision),
    rollbackReadbackImpl: () => liveRollbackReadback(),
    runPsqlImpl: () => {
      call += 1;
      if (call === 1) return JSON.stringify(stages[0]);
      if (call === 2) return stages.map((state, index) => JSON.stringify({
        index,
        kind: 'feature-successor-rehearsal-stage',
        serverVersionNum: 170006,
        state,
      })).join('\n');
      return JSON.stringify(changedRestore);
    },
  })).toThrow('FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_REHEARSAL_RESTORE_INVALID');
  const journal = readFileSync(
    join(custodyDirectory, FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_FILES.rehearsalJournal),
    'utf8',
  ).trimEnd().split('\n').map(line => JSON.parse(line));
  expect(journal).toHaveLength(2);
  expect(journal[1]).toMatchObject({
    code: 'FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_REHEARSAL_RESTORE_INVALID',
    event: 'terminal',
  });
  expect(existsSync(join(custodyDirectory, FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_FILES.rehearsalReceipt))).toBe(false);
});

});

test('tampered parent provenance, rehearsal admission, and future journals cannot seed the feature phase', () => {
  const tampered = createCommittedPredecessor();
  const machinePath = join(tampered.custodyDirectory, 'apply-machine-operating-observations.json');
  const machine = JSON.parse(readFileSync(machinePath, 'utf8'));
  machine.automaticReviewer.state = 'running';
  writeCanonical(machinePath, machine);
  expect(() => prepareFeatureRehearsalAdmission({
    custodyDirectory: tampered.custodyDirectory,
    loadManifestImpl: () => featureRecord,
    now: fixedNow,
  })).toThrow('FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_ADMISSION_INVALID');

  const relabeled = createCommittedPredecessor();
  const rehearsalPath = join(relabeled.custodyDirectory, 'rehearsal-admission.json');
  const rehearsal = JSON.parse(readFileSync(rehearsalPath, 'utf8'));
  rehearsal.attemptId = '123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174299';
  writeCanonical(rehearsalPath, rehearsal);
  expect(() => prepareFeatureRehearsalAdmission({
    custodyDirectory: relabeled.custodyDirectory,
    loadManifestImpl: () => featureRecord,
    now: fixedNow,
  })).toThrow('FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_ADMISSION_INVALID');

  const future = createCommittedPredecessor();
  const journalPath = join(future.custodyDirectory, FEATURE_SUCCESSOR_FILES.baseJournal);
  const journal = readFileSync(journalPath, 'utf8').trimEnd().split('\n').map(line => JSON.parse(line));

type DatabaseMetadata = {
  name: string;
  owner: string;
  encoding: string;
  collate: string;
  ctype: string;
  localeProvider: string;
  allowConnections: boolean;
  isTemplate: boolean;
};

type DatabaseState = {
  target: DatabaseMetadata | null;
  template: DatabaseMetadata;
};

const templateDatabaseMetadata: DatabaseMetadata = {
  name: 'ranking_clone',
  owner: 'postgres',
  encoding: 'UTF8',
  collate: 'C',
  ctype: 'C',
  localeProvider: 'c',
  allowConnections: true,
  isTemplate: false,
};

function databaseNameFromSql(sql: string) {
  const queryMatch = sql.match(/target_database\.datname='([^']+)'/);
  const commandMatch = sql.match(/(?:CREATE|DROP) DATABASE ([a-z0-9_]+)/);
  const databaseName = queryMatch?.[1] || commandMatch?.[1];
  if (!databaseName) throw new Error(`database name missing from SQL: ${sql.slice(0, 80)}`);
  return databaseName;
}

function databaseState(databaseName: string, targetOwner = 'postgres'): DatabaseState {
  return {
    target: {
      ...templateDatabaseMetadata,
      name: databaseName,
      owner: targetOwner,
      isTemplate: false,
    },
    template: { ...templateDatabaseMetadata },
  };
}

function emptyDatabaseState(): DatabaseState {
  return { target: null, template: { ...templateDatabaseMetadata } };
}

function databaseOwnership() {
  return {
    database: false,
    databaseAttempted: false,
    databaseName: null,
    databaseBaseline: null,
  };
}

test('successor acknowledgement loss reconciles a committed terminal state without SQL replay', () => {
  const baselineState = { bundle: { targetCount: 0 }, state: { terminalContractReady: false } };
  const terminalState = { bundle: { targetCount: 11 }, state: { terminalContractReady: true } };
  let state = baselineState;
  const sqlCalls: string[] = [];
  let readbacks = 0;

  const application = applySuccessorPlanOnce({
    database: 'fixture_database',
    sql: 'BEGIN; SELECT successor_mutation(); COMMIT;',
    stateQuery: 'SELECT successor_state();',
    baselineState,
    terminalState,
    psqlImpl: (_database: string, sql: string) => {
      sqlCalls.push(sql);
      state = terminalState;
      throw new Error('response lost after commit');
    },
    readStateImpl: (_database: string, query: string) => {
      expect(query).toBe('SELECT successor_state();');
      readbacks += 1;
      return state;
    },
  });

  expect(application.outcome).toBe('committed-after-acknowledgement-loss');
  expect(JSON.parse(application.result.stdout.trim())).toEqual(terminalState);
  expect(sqlCalls).toEqual(['BEGIN; SELECT successor_mutation(); COMMIT;']);
  expect(readbacks).toBe(1);
});

test('retained proof is checksum-verified and distinguished from the current harness source', () => {
  const manifestBytes = readFileSync(new URL('../../../.github/review-media-sql-successor.v1.json', import.meta.url));
  const manifest = JSON.parse(manifestBytes.toString('utf8'));
  const harnessBytes = readFileSync(new URL(
    '../performance/review-db-successor-20261012/verify-review-media-sql-successor.mjs',
    import.meta.url,
  ));
  const retained = inspectRetainedProof({
    currentBindings: {
      manifestSha256: sha256(manifestBytes),
      rehearsalHarnessSha256: sha256(harnessBytes),
      sourceRoot: manifest.sourceRoot,
    },
  });

  expect(retained).toMatchObject({
    present: true,
    classification: 'retained-historical-evidence',
    repositoryPath: retainedProofRepositoryPath,
    expectedSha256: '6f5dc5c5603c8a4d8b601d3edb28009e454e955292a65707747e66f274557b3f',
    actualSha256: '6f5dc5c5603c8a4d8b601d3edb28009e454e955292a65707747e66f274557b3f',
    currentSourceMatch: false,
    usedAsCurrentProof: false,
  });
  expect(retained.bindingDifferences.some(({ field }: { field: string }) => (
    field === 'rehearsalHarnessSha256'
  ))).toBe(true);
});

test('retained proof with bytes not authorized by SHA256SUMS is rejected', () => {
  const directory = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'tzudong-retained-proof-'));
  try {
    const outputPath = join(directory, 'pg17-local-replay.json');
    const checksumsPath = join(directory, 'SHA256SUMS');
    const proof = Buffer.from(`${JSON.stringify({
      status: 'passed',
      temporaryDatabaseDropped: true,
      hostedWrites: false,
      operatingWrites: false,
      manifestSha256: '1'.repeat(64),
      rehearsalHarnessSha256: '2'.repeat(64),
      sourceRoot: '3'.repeat(64),
    })}\n`);
    writeFileSync(outputPath, proof);
    const checksumBytes = `${sha256(proof)}  ${retainedProofRepositoryPath}\n`;
    writeFileSync(checksumsPath, checksumBytes);
    writeFileSync(`${checksumsPath}.sha256`, `${sha256(checksumBytes)}\n`);
    writeFileSync(outputPath, Buffer.concat([proof, Buffer.from(' ')]));

    expect(() => inspectRetainedProof({
      outputPath,
      checksumsPath,
      currentBindings: {
        manifestSha256: '1'.repeat(64),
        rehearsalHarnessSha256: '2'.repeat(64),
        sourceRoot: '3'.repeat(64),
      },
    })).toThrow('LOCAL_REHEARSAL_RETAINED_SHA256_MISMATCH');
  } finally {
    rmSync(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});

test('jointly altered retained proof and checksum map are rejected by the independent digest', () => {
  const directory = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'tzudong-retained-map-tamper-'));
  try {

      operatingWrites: false, manifestSha256: '1'.repeat(64),
      rehearsalHarnessSha256: '2'.repeat(64), sourceRoot: '3'.repeat(64) };
    const original = Buffer.from(`${JSON.stringify(proof)}\n`);
    const originalMap = `${sha256(original)}  ${retainedProofRepositoryPath}\n`;
    writeFileSync(`${checksumsPath}.sha256`, `${sha256(originalMap)}\n`);
    const tampered = Buffer.from(`${JSON.stringify({ ...proof, sourceRoot: '4'.repeat(64) })}\n`);
    writeFileSync(outputPath, tampered);
    writeFileSync(checksumsPath, `${sha256(tampered)}  ${retainedProofRepositoryPath}\n`);
    expect(() => inspectRetainedProof({ outputPath, checksumsPath, currentBindings: {
      manifestSha256: '1'.repeat(64), rehearsalHarnessSha256: '2'.repeat(64), sourceRoot: '4'.repeat(64),
    } })).toThrow('LOCAL_REHEARSAL_CHECKSUMS_SHA256_MISMATCH');
  } finally {
    rmSync(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});

  ['fixture', 7, 'fixture failed'],

    let databaseName = '';
    let databaseCalls = 0;
    let drops = 0;

      scalarImpl: (_database: string, sql: string) => {
        const requestedName = databaseNameFromSql(sql);
        return JSON.stringify(databaseExists ? databaseState(requestedName) : emptyDatabaseState());
      },
      readFileImpl: () => Buffer.from('-- predecessor fixture'),
      psqlImpl: (database: string, sql: string | Buffer) => {
        const statement = sql.toString();
        if (database === 'postgres' && statement.startsWith('CREATE DATABASE ')) {
          databaseName = databaseNameFromSql(statement);
          databaseExists = true;
          return {};
        }
        if (database === 'postgres' && statement.startsWith('DROP DATABASE ')) {
          databaseExists = false;
          drops += 1;
          return {};
        }
        databaseCalls += 1;
        if (databaseCalls === failingDatabaseCall) throw new Error(`${label} failed`);
        return {};
      },
    };

      expect(ownership.database).toBe(true);
    } finally {
      dropOwnedDatabase(ownership, dependencies);
    }

    expect(databaseExists).toBe(false);
    expect(ownership.database).toBe(false);
    expect(drops).toBe(1);
  });

    expect(shouldSuppressOcrAutoNavigation({
      lastManualInteractionAt: 10_000,

    })).toBe(true);

    expect(shouldSuppressOcrAutoNavigation({
      lastManualInteractionAt: 10_000,

      userStepOverride: false,
    })).toBe(false);
  });

  test('keeps automatic OCR navigation disabled after manual step movement', () => {
    expect(shouldSuppressOcrAutoNavigation({
      lastManualInteractionAt: 0,
      now: 20_000,
      userStepOverride: true,
    })).toBe(true);
  });

    const next = addAiFilledField(initial, 'review');

    expect([...initial]).toEqual(['date']);
    expect([...next].sort()).toEqual(['date', 'review']);
  });

  test('orders progress stages for the compact SSE timeline', () => {
    expect(getOcrProgressRank('prepare')).toBeLessThan(getOcrProgressRank('model_start'));
    expect(getOcrProgressRank('patching')).toBeLessThan(getOcrProgressRank('done'));
  });

  test('recovers an interrupted stream by bounded status reads without starting another model request', async () => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const processing = Object.assign(new Error('still processing'), { code: 'OCR_RESULT_PROCESSING' });
    const expected = { ocr_result_ref: '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111' };
    let statusReads = 0;
    let waits = 0;
    let modelRequests = 0;

    const result = await reconcileInterruptedOcrReadback({
      signal: controller.signal,
      readStatus: async () => {
        statusReads += 1;
        if (statusReads < 3) throw processing;
        return expected;
      },
      isProcessingError: error => (error as { code?: string }).code === 'OCR_RESULT_PROCESSING',
      wait: async () => { waits += 1; },
    });

    expect(result).toBe(expected);
    expect({ statusReads, waits, modelRequests }).toEqual({ statusReads: 3, waits: 2, modelRequests: 0 });
  });

  test('keeps indeterminate interrupted streams fail-closed without retrying or resending', async () => {
    const indeterminate = Object.assign(new Error('dispatch outcome unknown'), { code: 'OCR_RESULT_INDETERMINATE' });
    let statusReads = 0;
    let waits = 0;

    await expect(reconcileInterruptedOcrReadback({
      signal: new AbortController().signal,
      readStatus: async () => { statusReads += 1; throw indeterminate; },
      isProcessingError: error => (error as { code?: string }).code === 'OCR_RESULT_PROCESSING',
      wait: async () => { waits += 1; },
    })).rejects.toBe(indeterminate);
    expect({ statusReads, waits }).toEqual({ statusReads: 1, waits: 0 });
  });

  test('caps interrupted-stream processing reconciliation at four status reads', async () => {
    const processing = Object.assign(new Error('still processing'), { code: 'OCR_RESULT_PROCESSING' });
    let statusReads = 0;
    let waits = 0;

    await expect(reconcileInterruptedOcrReadback({
      signal: new AbortController().signal,
      attempts: 99,
      delayMs: 0,
      readStatus: async () => { statusReads += 1; throw processing; },
      isProcessingError: error => (error as { code?: string }).code === 'OCR_RESULT_PROCESSING',
      wait: async () => { waits += 1; },
    })).rejects.toBe(processing);
    expect(statusReads).toBe(INTERRUPTED_OCR_READBACK_ATTEMPTS);
    expect(waits).toBe(INTERRUPTED_OCR_READBACK_ATTEMPTS - 1);
  });

  test('stops interrupted-stream reconciliation when the current receipt is cancelled', async () => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const processing = Object.assign(new Error('still processing'), { code: 'OCR_RESULT_PROCESSING' });
    let statusReads = 0;

    await expect(reconcileInterruptedOcrReadback({
      signal: controller.signal,
      readStatus: async () => { statusReads += 1; throw processing; },
      isProcessingError: error => (error as { code?: string }).code === 'OCR_RESULT_PROCESSING',
      wait: async () => { controller.abort(); controller.signal.throwIfAborted(); },
    })).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'AbortError' });
    expect(statusReads).toBe(1);
  });
});

function nodeText(text: string, name: string): string {
    const tree = ts.createSourceFile('fixture.tsx', text, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, ts.ScriptKind.TSX);
    let found: ts.Node | undefined;
    function visit(node: ts.Node) {
        if (ts.isFunctionDeclaration(node) && node.name?.text === name) found = node;
        if (ts.isVariableDeclaration(node) && node.name.getText(tree) === name) found = node.initializer;
        if (!found) ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
    }
    visit(tree);
    if (!found) throw new Error('FIXTURE_NODE_MISSING');
    return found.getText(tree);
}

        const receiptOcrSelection = createLatestSelection();
        let ocrPreparationLease: LatestSelectionLease | null = null;
        const receiptOcrPreparationRef = {
            current: {
                ...receiptOcrSelection,
                begin: () => {
                    ocrPreparationLease = receiptOcrSelection.begin();
                    return ocrPreparationLease;
                },
            },
        };
        const verificationInputModeRef = { current: 'ai' as 'ai' | 'manual' };
        const ocrRunGenerationRef = { current: 0 };
        const ocrAbortControllerRef: { current: AbortController | null } = { current: null };
        const userStepOverrideDuringOcrRef = { current: false };
        let renderedMode: 'ai' | 'manual' = 'ai';
        let attached: File | null = null;
        let analyzeCalls = 0;
        let compressorSignal: AbortSignal | undefined;
        let enterCompressor!: () => void;
        let finishCompression!: (blob: Blob) => void;
        const compressorEntered = new Promise<void>(resolve => { enterCompressor = resolve; });
        const compressed = new Promise<Blob>(resolve => { finishCompression = resolve; });

        const setMode = evaluate(`${nodeText(source, 'setReceiptVerificationInputMode')};`, {
            useCallback: (callback: unknown) => callback,
            verificationInputModeRef, receiptOcrPreparationRef, ocrRunGenerationRef, ocrAbortControllerRef,
            userStepOverrideDuringOcrRef, latestSaveInputsRef: { current: {} },
            reviseLatestSaveInputs() {},
            setVerificationInputMode(value: 'ai' | 'manual') { renderedMode = value; },
            setOcrResultRef() {}, setOcrResultRevision() {},
            setIsAnalyzing() {}, setOcrProgress() {}, setOcrFallbackNotice() {},
        }) as (mode: 'ai' | 'manual') => void;
        const selectPhoto = evaluate(`${nodeText(source, 'handleVerificationPhotoSelected')};`, {
            verificationSelectionRef, receiptOcrPreparationRef, verificationInputModeRef,
            ocrRunGenerationRef, ocrAbortControllerRef,
            reviseLatestSaveInputs() {},
            setIsAnalyzing() {}, setOcrProgress() {}, featureHeld: false,
            isSupportedReceiptImage: () => true, toast() {}, FEATURE_DATABASE_HELD_MESSAGE: 'held',
            generateSafeFilename: () => 'prepared.jpg', prepareVerificationUploadFile,
            imageCompression: async (_file: File, options: { signal?: AbortSignal }) => {
                compressorSignal = options.signal;
                enterCompressor();
                return compressed;
            },
            replaceVerificationPhoto(file: File, generation: number) {
                expect(verificationSelectionRef.current.isCurrent(generation)).toBe(true);
                attached = file;
                return true;
            },
            verificationFileInputRef: { current: null },
            window: { setTimeout: (callback: () => void) => globalThis.setTimeout(callback, 0) },
            analyzeReceipt() { analyzeCalls += 1; }, ReceiptUploadPreparationError,
        }) as (file: File) => Promise<void>;
        const original = new File(
            [new Uint8Array(OCR_REVIEW_VERIFICATION_MAX_BYTES + 1)],
            'slow-receipt.jpg',
            { type: 'image/jpeg' },
        );

        const selection = selectPhoto(original);
        await compressorEntered;
        setMode('manual');
        expect(ocrPreparationLease?.signal.aborted).toBe(true);
        expect(compressorSignal?.aborted).toBe(false);
        finishCompression(new Blob([new Uint8Array(1024)], { type: 'image/jpeg' }));
        await selection;
        await new Promise(resolve => globalThis.setTimeout(resolve, 0));

        expect(attached?.size).toBe(1024);
        expect(analyzeCalls).toBe(0);
        expect(renderedMode).toBe('manual');
        expect(verificationInputModeRef.current).toBe('manual');
        expect(userStepOverrideDuringOcrRef.current).toBe(true);
    });

    test('removing a receipt cancels analysis and clears its busy state', () => {
        const controller = new AbortController();

    });

    test('a buffered stream frame cannot patch fields after cancellation', async () => {
        let finishRead!: (value: unknown) => void;
        let enteredRead!: () => void;
        const started = new Promise<void>(resolve => { enteredRead = resolve; });
        const pending = new Promise(resolve => { finishRead = resolve; });
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const context = { id: 'original-restaurant', categories: ['한식'] };
        const recoveryRef = { current: null as unknown };
        let patches = 0;
        const stream = evaluate(`${nodeText(source, 'analyzeReceiptWithStream')};`, {
            useCallback: (callback: unknown) => callback, FormData, TextDecoder,
            selectedRestaurant: context, restaurant: null, ocrRecoveryContextRef: recoveryRef,
            appendSelectedRestaurantOcrContext() {},
            fetch: async () => ({ ok: true, body: { getReader: () => ({ read: () => { enteredRead(); return pending; } }) } }),
            parseOcrStreamFrame: () => ({ event: 'field_patch', payload: { data: { date: '2026-10-15' } } }),
            handleOcrStreamEvent() { patches++; },
        }) as (file: File, token: string, signal: AbortSignal, force: boolean) => Promise<unknown>;
        const file = new File(['receipt'], 'receipt.jpg');
        const run = stream(file, 'offline-session-token', controller.signal, false);
        await started;
        controller.abort();
        finishRead({ done: false, value: new TextEncoder().encode('event: field_patch\ndata: {}\n\n') });
        await expect(run).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'AbortError' });
        expect(patches).toBe(0);
        expect(recoveryRef.current).toEqual({ file, restaurant: context });
    });

    test('status readback keeps the original restaurant context after form edits', async () => {
        const file = new File(['same receipt'], 'receipt.jpg');
        const original = { id: 'original-restaurant', name: 'Original' };
        const current = { id: 'edited-restaurant', name: 'Edited' };
        let sentContext: unknown;
        let requests = 0;
        const read = evaluate(`${nodeText(source, 'readReceiptOcrStatus')};`, {
            useCallback: (callback: unknown) => callback, FormData,
            selectedRestaurant: current, restaurant: null,
            ocrRecoveryContextRef: { current: { file, restaurant: original } },
            appendSelectedRestaurantOcrContext(_form: FormData, context: unknown) { sentContext = context; },
            fetch: async (url: string) => {
                expect(url).toBe('/api/ocr/results/status'); requests++;
                return { status: 200, json: async () => ({}) };
            },
        }) as (file: File, token: string, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<unknown>;
        await read(file, 'offline-session-token', new AbortController().signal);
        expect(requests).toBe(1);
        expect(sentContext).toBe(original);
        await read(new File(['new receipt'], 'new.jpg'), 'offline-session-token', new AbortController().signal);
        expect(requests).toBe(2);
        expect(sentContext).toBe(current);
    });

    test('a late stored result cannot update a newer receipt selection', async () => {
        const ocrRunGenerationRef = { current: 0 };
        const ocrAbortControllerRef: { current: AbortController | null } = { current: null };
        let finishRead!: (value: unknown) => void;
        let enteredRead!: () => void;
        const started = new Promise<void>(resolve => { enteredRead = resolve; });
        const pending = new Promise(resolve => { finishRead = resolve; });
        const effects = { result: 0, fields: 0, notices: 0 };
        const receiptOcrPreparationRef = { current: createLatestSelection() };
        const verificationInputModeRef = { current: 'ai' as 'ai' | 'manual' };
        const userStepOverrideDuringOcrRef = { current: false };
        const setMode = evaluate(`${nodeText(source, 'setReceiptVerificationInputMode')};`, {
            useCallback: (callback: unknown) => callback,
            verificationInputModeRef, receiptOcrPreparationRef, ocrRunGenerationRef, ocrAbortControllerRef,
            userStepOverrideDuringOcrRef, latestSaveInputsRef: { current: {} },
            reviseLatestSaveInputs() {},
            setVerificationInputMode() {}, setOcrResultRef() {}, setOcrResultRevision() {},
            setIsAnalyzing() {}, setOcrProgress() {}, setOcrFallbackNotice() {},
        }) as (mode: 'ai' | 'manual') => void;
        const analyze = evaluate(`${nodeText(source, 'analyzeReceipt')}\nanalyzeReceipt;`, {
            AbortController, featureHeld: false, user: { id: 'fixture-owner' },
            canForceOcrRefresh: false, forceOcrRefresh: false,
            ocrRunGenerationRef, ocrAbortControllerRef,
            reviseLatestSaveInputs() {},
            setIsAnalyzing() {}, setOcrProgress() {}, setOcrFallbackNotice() {},
            supabase: { auth: { getSession: async () => ({ data: { session: { access_token: 'offline-session-token' } } }) } },
            readReceiptOcrStatus: () => { enteredRead(); return pending; },
            setOcrResultRef() { effects.result++; }, setOcrResultRevision() { effects.result++; },
            applyOcrFieldPatch() { effects.fields++; }, revealOcrAutoFillSequence() { effects.fields++; },
            manuallyEditedOcrFieldsRef: { current: new Set() },
            canReplaceSelectedRestaurantFromOcr: () => false,
            selectedRestaurant: null, restaurant: null, mutateQuota() {},
            isAbortError: (error: unknown) => error instanceof Error && error.name === 'AbortError',
            isPendingOcrStreamError: () => false,
            toast() { effects.notices++; },
        }) as (file: File, generation: number | undefined, statusOnly: boolean) => Promise<void>;
        const run = analyze(new File(['old receipt'], 'old.jpg'), undefined, true);
        await started;
        setMode('manual');
        // A completed request can settle after cancellation; its payload must
        // still be ignored even if a transport/mock does not reject on abort.
        finishRead({ ocr_result_ref: '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111',
            ocr_result_revision: '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222' });
        await run;
        expect(effects).toEqual({ result: 0, fields: 0, notices: 0 });
        expect(verificationInputModeRef.current).toBe('manual');
        expect(userStepOverrideDuringOcrRef.current).toBe(true);
        expect(ocrAbortControllerRef.current).toBeNull();
    });

    test('direct input cancels deferred status readback after an interrupted SSE stream', async () => {
        const ocrRunGenerationRef = { current: 0 };
        const ocrAbortControllerRef: { current: AbortController | null } = { current: null };
        const receiptOcrPreparationRef = { current: createLatestSelection() };
        const verificationInputModeRef = { current: 'ai' as 'ai' | 'manual' };
        const userStepOverrideDuringOcrRef = { current: false };
        const manuallyEditedOcrFieldsRef = { current: new Set<string>() };
        const lastManualOcrInteractionAtRef = { current: 0 };
        const lastOcrRevealSignatureRef = { current: null as string | null };
        let finishRead!: (value: unknown) => void;
        let enterRead!: () => void;
        const readStarted = new Promise<void>(resolve => { enterRead = resolve; });
        const delayedStatus = new Promise(resolve => { finishRead = resolve; });
        const effects = { result: 0, fields: 0, navigation: 0 };
        const setMode = evaluate(`${nodeText(source, 'setReceiptVerificationInputMode')};`, {
            useCallback: (callback: unknown) => callback,
            verificationInputModeRef, receiptOcrPreparationRef, ocrRunGenerationRef, ocrAbortControllerRef,

            reviseLatestSaveInputs() {},
            setVerificationInputMode() {}, setOcrResultRef() {}, setOcrResultRevision() {},
            setIsAnalyzing() {}, setOcrProgress() {}, setOcrFallbackNotice() {},
        }) as (mode: 'ai' | 'manual') => void;
        const analyze = evaluate(`${nodeText(source, 'analyzeReceipt')}\nanalyzeReceipt;`, {
            AbortController, featureHeld: false, user: { id: 'fixture-owner' },
            canForceOcrRefresh: false, forceOcrRefresh: false,
            ocrRunGenerationRef, ocrAbortControllerRef, manuallyEditedOcrFieldsRef,
            reviseLatestSaveInputs() {},
            lastManualOcrInteractionAtRef, lastOcrRevealSignatureRef, userStepOverrideDuringOcrRef,
            setIsAnalyzing() {}, setOcrProgress() {}, setOcrFallbackNotice() {}, setAiFilledFields() {},
            supabase: { auth: { getSession: async () => ({ data: { session: { access_token: 'offline-session-token' } } }) } },
            analyzeReceiptWithStream: async () => { throw new Error('synthetic interrupted stream'); },

            reconcileInterruptedOcrReadback,
            isTerminalOcrStreamError: () => false,
            isPendingOcrStreamError: () => false,
            isAbortError: (error: unknown) => error instanceof Error && error.name === 'AbortError',
            setOcrResultRef() { effects.result += 1; }, setOcrResultRevision() { effects.result += 1; },
            applyOcrFieldPatch() { effects.fields += 1; },
            revealOcrAutoFillSequence() { effects.navigation += 1; },
            canReplaceSelectedRestaurantFromOcr: () => false,
            selectedRestaurant: null, restaurant: null, mutateQuota() {}, toast() {},
        }) as (file: File) => Promise<void>;

        const run = analyze(new File(['receipt'], 'receipt.jpg'));
        await readStarted;
        setMode('manual');
        finishRead({
            ocr_result_ref: '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111',
            ocr_result_revision: '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222',

        expect(effects).toEqual({ result: 0, fields: 0, navigation: 0 });
        expect(verificationInputModeRef.current).toBe('manual');
        expect(userStepOverrideDuringOcrRef.current).toBe(true);
        expect(ocrAbortControllerRef.current).toBeNull();
    });

    test('status-only readback preserves manual edits and navigation without another model request', async () => {
        const edits = new Set(['date', 'review']);
        const manuallyEditedOcrFieldsRef = { current: edits };
        const lastManualOcrInteractionAtRef = { current: 1234 };
        const userStepOverrideDuringOcrRef = { current: true };
        const lastOcrRevealSignatureRef = { current: 'previous-reveal' };
        const stopped = new DOMException('Offline readback stopped', 'AbortError');
        let reads = 0;
        let modelRequests = 0;
        let markerResets = 0;
        const analyze = evaluate(`${nodeText(source, 'analyzeReceipt')}\nanalyzeReceipt;`, {
            AbortController,
            featureHeld: false,
            user: { id: 'fixture-owner' },
            canForceOcrRefresh: false,
            forceOcrRefresh: false,
            manuallyEditedOcrFieldsRef,
            reviseLatestSaveInputs() {},
            lastManualOcrInteractionAtRef,
            userStepOverrideDuringOcrRef,
            lastOcrRevealSignatureRef,
            ocrRunGenerationRef: { current: 0 },
            ocrAbortControllerRef: { current: null },
            setIsAnalyzing() {}, setOcrProgress() {}, setOcrFallbackNotice() {},
            setAiFilledFields() { markerResets++; },
            supabase: { auth: { getSession: async () => ({ data: { session: { access_token: 'offline-session-token' } } }) } },
            readReceiptOcrStatus: async () => { reads++; throw stopped; },
            analyzeReceiptWithStream: async () => { modelRequests++; throw new Error('UNEXPECTED_MODEL_REQUEST'); },
            isAbortError: (error: unknown) => error === stopped,
        }) as (file: File, generation: number | undefined, statusOnly: boolean) => Promise<void>;

        await analyze(new File(['receipt'], 'receipt.jpg'), undefined, true);

        expect(reads).toBe(1);
        expect(modelRequests).toBe(0);
        expect(markerResets).toBe(0);
        expect(manuallyEditedOcrFieldsRef.current).toBe(edits);
        expect([...manuallyEditedOcrFieldsRef.current]).toEqual(['date', 'review']);
        expect(lastManualOcrInteractionAtRef.current).toBe(1234);
        expect(userStepOverrideDuringOcrRef.current).toBe(true);
        expect(lastOcrRevealSignatureRef.current).toBe('previous-reveal');
    });

describe('actual ReviewModal submit and Supabase adapter', () => {
    test('receipt selection and preparation enforce the private bucket MIME allowlist', () => {
        expect(source).toContain('SUPPORTED_RECEIPT_MIME_TYPES.has(file.type)');
        expect(source).toContain('preparedFile = await prepareVerificationUploadFile({');
        expect(source).toContain('분석 요청은 전송되지 않았습니다.');
        expect(source).not.toContain('영수증 리사이즈 실패, 원본 사용');
        expect(source.match(/accept=\{RECEIPT_IMAGE_ACCEPT\}/g)?.length).toBe(3);
        expect(source).toContain('const imageFiles = files.filter(isSupportedReceiptImage);');
    });
    test('saved cleanup owns its revision even after the current restaurant selection is cleared', async () => {
        const f = fixture(); await f.submit();
        const clear = evaluate(`${nodeText(source, 'clearDraft')};`, {
            ...f.bindings, selectedRestaurant: null, restaurant: null,
            setLastSavedAt() {}, useCallback: (callback: unknown) => callback,
        }) as () => Promise<boolean>;
        expect(await clear()).toBe(true);
        expect(f.rows.size).toBe(1); expect(f.counts.inserts).toBe(1);
        expect(f.counts.removes).toBe(0); expect(f.objects.size).toBe(2);
    });
    test('known success writes pending review with canonical owner/review-bound photos', async () => {
        const f = fixture(); await f.submit();
        expect(f.rows.size).toBe(1); expect(f.objects.size).toBe(2);
        expect(f.counts).toEqual({ uploads: 2, inserts: 1, removes: 0, reads: 0, cleared: 1, success: 1, closes: 1 });
        const row = [...f.rows.values()][0]; expect(row.is_verified).toBe(false); expect(row.user_id).toBe('fixture-owner');
        expect(row.verification_photo.startsWith(`${row.user_id}/reviews/${row.id}/verification/`)).toBe(true);
        expect(row.food_photos[0].startsWith(`${row.user_id}/reviews/${row.id}/food/`)).toBe(true);
    });
    test('photo-only mode clears a completed OCR binding and uses the standard review insert', async () => {
        const f = fixture();
        f.bindings.verificationInputModeRef.current = 'ai';

            ocrResultRevision: '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222',
        };
        const cleared = { ref: false, revision: false };
        const setMode = evaluate(`${nodeText(source, 'setReceiptVerificationInputMode')};`, {
            useCallback: (callback: unknown) => callback,
            verificationInputModeRef: f.bindings.verificationInputModeRef,
            receiptOcrPreparationRef: { current: createLatestSelection() },
            ocrRunGenerationRef: f.bindings.ocrRunGenerationRef, ocrAbortControllerRef: { current: null },

            setVerificationInputMode() {},
            setOcrResultRef(value: null) { cleared.ref = value === null; },
            setOcrResultRevision(value: null) { cleared.revision = value === null; },

    test.each(['manual', 'ai'] as const)('blocks an oversized %s review before any upload', async mode => {

    test('accepts exactly 4,000 normalized characters and persists the normalized content', async () => {

    test.each([

        { name: 'partial result', isAnalyzing: false, ref: '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111', revision: null },
