CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE pg_temp.g014_feature_membership_before ON COMMIT DROP AS
SELECT pg_catalog.to_jsonb(membership) AS row_value
FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members AS membership;

DO $prerequisites$
DECLARE
  required record;
  procedure_oid oid;
  procedure_row pg_catalog.pg_proc%ROWTYPE;
  archive_guard_oid oid;
  generation_trigger_oid oid;
BEGIN
  IF pg_catalog.current_setting('server_version_num')::integer / 10000 <> 17
     OR current_user <> 'postgres'
     OR session_user <> 'postgres'
     OR pg_catalog.current_setting('transaction_read_only') <> 'off' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'G014_FEATURE_RPC_EXECUTOR_DENIED';
  END IF;

  IF pg_catalog.to_regclass('privacy_retention.g014_public_rpc_allowlist') IS NULL
     OR pg_catalog.to_regclass('privacy_retention.g014_nested_helper_allowlist') IS NULL
     OR pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('privacy_retention.assert_g014_public_rpc_allowlist()') IS NULL
     OR pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('privacy_retention.assert_g014_definer_contract()') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'G014_FEATURE_RPC_CATALOG_PREREQUISITE_MISSING';
  END IF;

  FOR required IN
    SELECT * FROM pg_temp.g014_feature_rpc_registry ORDER BY source_signature
  LOOP
    procedure_oid := pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(required.source_signature);
    SELECT procedure.* INTO procedure_row
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc AS procedure
    WHERE procedure.oid = procedure_oid;

    IF procedure_oid IS NULL
       OR procedure_row.proowner <> 'postgres'::regrole
       OR NOT procedure_row.prosecdef
       OR procedure_row.proconfig IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['search_path=""']::text[]
       OR procedure_row.prokind <> 'f'
       OR procedure_row.provolatile <> required.expected_volatility
       OR procedure_row.prolang <> (
         SELECT language.oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_language AS language
         WHERE language.lanname = 'plpgsql'
       )
       OR procedure_row.prorettype <> required.expected_return_type
       OR procedure_row.proretset IS DISTINCT FROM required.expected_set
       OR NOT pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('service_role', procedure_oid, 'EXECUTE')
       OR pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('anon', procedure_oid, 'EXECUTE')
       OR pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('authenticated', procedure_oid, 'EXECUTE')
       OR EXISTS (
         SELECT 1
         FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(
           coalesce(
             procedure_row.proacl,
             pg_catalog.acldefault('f', procedure_row.proowner)
           )
         ) AS acl
         WHERE acl.privilege_type = 'EXECUTE'
           AND (
             acl.grantee = 0
             OR pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantee) NOT IN ('postgres', 'service_role')
             OR (pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantee) = 'service_role' AND acl.is_grantable)
           )
       ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'G014_FEATURE_RPC_PREREQUISITE_DRIFT: %', required.source_signature;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  generation_trigger_oid := pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(
    'ocr_private.register_review_ocr_generation()'
  );
  SELECT procedure.* INTO procedure_row
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc AS procedure
  WHERE procedure.oid = generation_trigger_oid;

  IF generation_trigger_oid IS NULL
     OR procedure_row.proowner <> 'postgres'::regrole
     OR NOT procedure_row.prosecdef
     OR procedure_row.proconfig IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['search_path=""']::text[]
     OR procedure_row.prokind <> 'f'
     OR procedure_row.prorettype <> 'trigger'::regtype
     OR procedure_row.proretset
     OR procedure_row.prolang <> (
       SELECT language.oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_language AS language
       WHERE language.lanname = 'plpgsql'
     )
     OR pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('anon', generation_trigger_oid, 'EXECUTE')
     OR pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('authenticated', generation_trigger_oid, 'EXECUTE')
     OR pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('service_role', generation_trigger_oid, 'EXECUTE')
     OR (
       SELECT pg_catalog.count(*)
       FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger AS trigger_row
       WHERE trigger_row.tgfoid = generation_trigger_oid
         AND trigger_row.tgrelid = 'public.reviews'::regclass
         AND trigger_row.tgname IN (
           'review_ocr_generation_on_insert',
           'review_ocr_generation_on_reset'
         )
         AND trigger_row.tgenabled = 'O'
         AND NOT trigger_row.tgisinternal
     ) <> 2 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'G014_FEATURE_GENERATION_TRIGGER_PREREQUISITE_DRIFT';
  END IF;

  archive_guard_oid := pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(
    'public.storyboard_production_reject_archived_write()'
  );
  SELECT procedure.* INTO procedure_row
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc AS procedure
  WHERE procedure.oid = archive_guard_oid;

  IF archive_guard_oid IS NULL
     OR procedure_row.proowner <> 'postgres'::regrole
     OR procedure_row.prosecdef
     OR procedure_row.proconfig IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['search_path=""']::text[]
     OR procedure_row.prokind <> 'f'
     OR procedure_row.prorettype <> 'trigger'::regtype
     OR procedure_row.proretset
     OR procedure_row.prolang <> (
       SELECT language.oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_language AS language
       WHERE language.lanname = 'plpgsql'
     )
     OR (
       SELECT pg_catalog.count(*)
       FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger AS trigger_row
       WHERE trigger_row.tgfoid = archive_guard_oid
         AND NOT trigger_row.tgisinternal
     ) <> 6 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'G014_FEATURE_TRIGGER_PREREQUISITE_DRIFT';
  END IF;
END;
$prerequisites$;

-- Trigger creation already succeeded in the predecessor transaction. PostgreSQL
-- checks EXECUTE when CREATE TRIGGER runs; firing an installed trigger does not
-- require exposing its implementation as a PostgREST RPC. The PG17.6 rehearsal
-- exercises the trigger after this revoke.
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.storyboard_production_reject_archived_write()
  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role, privacy_workflow_owner;

-- Keep the pre-existing privileged implementations private. The public API is
-- recreated below as workflow-owner wrappers, so the Data API never receives
-- EXECUTE on a postgres-owned implementation.
DO $move_helpers$
DECLARE
  required record;
  procedure_oid oid;
BEGIN
  FOR required IN
    SELECT * FROM pg_temp.g014_feature_rpc_registry ORDER BY source_signature
  LOOP
    procedure_oid := pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(required.source_signature);
    EXECUTE pg_catalog.format(
      'ALTER FUNCTION %s SET SCHEMA ocr_private',
      procedure_oid::regprocedure
    );
    EXECUTE pg_catalog.format(
      'REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION %s FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role, privacy_workflow_owner',
      procedure_oid::regprocedure
    );
    EXECUTE pg_catalog.format(
      'GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION %s TO privacy_workflow_owner',
      procedure_oid::regprocedure
    );
  END LOOP;
END;
$move_helpers$;

GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA ocr_private TO privacy_workflow_owner;

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE pg_temp.g014_feature_self_membership_before (
  inherit_option boolean NOT NULL,
  set_option boolean NOT NULL
) ON COMMIT DROP;

INSERT INTO pg_temp.g014_feature_self_membership_before (
  inherit_option,
  set_option
)
SELECT membership.inherit_option, membership.set_option
FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members AS membership
WHERE membership.roleid = 'privacy_workflow_owner'::regrole
  AND membership.member = 'postgres'::regrole
  AND membership.grantor = 'postgres'::regrole;

DO $lease_workflow_owner$
DECLARE
  workflow_owner oid := 'privacy_workflow_owner'::regrole;
  runner oid := 'postgres'::regrole;
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members AS membership
    WHERE membership.roleid = workflow_owner
      AND membership.member = runner
      AND membership.grantor = runner
      AND membership.admin_option
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'G014_FEATURE_RPC_SELF_MEMBERSHIP_DENIED';
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members AS membership
    WHERE membership.roleid = workflow_owner
      AND membership.member = runner
      AND membership.admin_option
      AND membership.grantor <> runner
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'G014_FEATURE_RPC_OWNER_AUTHORITY_MISSING';
  END IF;

  GRANT privacy_workflow_owner TO postgres
    WITH ADMIN FALSE, INHERIT FALSE, SET TRUE
    GRANTED BY postgres;
END;
$lease_workflow_owner$;

SET LOCAL ROLE privacy_workflow_owner;

INSERT INTO privacy_retention.g014_public_rpc_allowlist (
  function_schema,
  function_name,
  identity_arguments,
  grantee,
  source_signature
)
SELECT
  namespace.nspname,
  procedure.proname,
  procedure.proargtypes::text,
  'service_role'::name,
  required.source_signature
FROM pg_temp.g014_feature_rpc_registry AS required
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS procedure
  ON procedure.oid = pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(required.source_signature)
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS namespace
  ON namespace.oid = procedure.pronamespace
ON CONFLICT (source_signature, grantee) DO UPDATE SET
  function_schema = EXCLUDED.function_schema,
  function_name = EXCLUDED.function_name,
  identity_arguments = EXCLUDED.identity_arguments;

DO $restore_workflow_owner_membership$
DECLARE
  self_membership record;
BEGIN

  FROM pg_temp.g014_feature_self_membership_before;

    REVOKE privacy_workflow_owner FROM postgres GRANTED BY postgres;
  ELSE
    EXECUTE pg_catalog.format(
      'GRANT privacy_workflow_owner TO postgres WITH ADMIN FALSE, INHERIT %s, SET %s GRANTED BY postgres',
      pg_catalog.upper(self_membership.inherit_option::text),
      pg_catalog.upper(self_membership.set_option::text)

  END IF;

===== BEGIN DDL backend/supabase/migrations/20261013190200_review_verification_immutable_key_fence.sql sha256=0a060ca537d3558779fd0cb1b780e7965189eb129f5018987f157c1cb5f2cd3d bytes=14358 group=evidence_prefixed_89_105 =====
-- Supabase CLI 2.117.0 generated this migration as
-- 20261013113348_review_verification_immutable_key_fence.sql. Before its first
-- application it was renamed so it sorts after the durable OCR result contract
-- (20261013190000) and its G014 RPC catalog integration (20261013190100).
--
-- Supabase Storage uploads first test the caller's RLS permission, write a
-- versioned object to the provider, and then complete the metadata transaction
-- as a privileged database actor. The restrictive policy rejects ordinary
-- authenticated UPDATE permission before an upsert can reach the provider. The
-- UPDATE trigger rejects privileged metadata replacement paths that bypass RLS.
-- DELETE stays available only for unreferenced canonical verification objects:
-- the delete trigger shares the review mutation lock and writes the durable
-- retirement tombstone before metadata disappears. This preserves owner,
-- guarded-admin and account-deletion cleanup after their review reference is
-- gone while preventing a later review from reattaching the deleted key. This
-- does not claim to lock provider bytes against credentials that write directly
-- to S3; those credentials remain an operating authority boundary.
BEGIN;
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '2s';
SELECT pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
  pg_catalog.hashtextextended('tzudong:review-verification-immutable-key:v1', 0)
);

CREATE TEMP TABLE review_verification_lease (
  pg_major integer NOT NULL,
  schema_lease boolean NOT NULL,
  pg15_membership_lease boolean NOT NULL,
  self_membership jsonb,
  before_members jsonb NOT NULL,
  before_schema jsonb NOT NULL
) ON COMMIT DROP;

DO $prepare$
DECLARE
  workflow_owner oid := 'privacy_workflow_owner'::regrole;
  runner oid := 'postgres'::regrole;
  pg_major integer := current_setting('server_version_num')::integer / 10000;
  schema_lease boolean;
  pg15_membership_lease boolean := false;
  self_membership jsonb;
  before_members jsonb;
  before_schema jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF current_user <> 'postgres'
    OR session_user <> 'postgres'
    OR pg_major NOT IN (15, 17)
    OR current_setting('transaction_read_only') <> 'off'
    OR to_regclass('storage.objects') IS NULL
    OR to_regnamespace('review_media_private') IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles
      WHERE oid = workflow_owner
        AND NOT rolsuper
        AND NOT rolbypassrls
        AND NOT rolcanlogin
        AND NOT rolinherit
    )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVIEW_VERIFICATION_IMMUTABLE_EXECUTOR_DENIED';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
    WHERE c.oid = 'storage.objects'::regclass
      AND c.relowner = 'supabase_storage_admin'::regrole
      AND c.relrowsecurity
      AND NOT c.relforcerowsecurity
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVIEW_VERIFICATION_STORAGE_CATALOG_DRIFT';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy p
    WHERE p.polrelid = 'storage.objects'::regclass
      AND p.polname = 'review_media_safe_update'
      AND p.polcmd = 'w'
      AND NOT p.polpermissive
      AND p.polroles = ARRAY['authenticated'::regrole::oid]
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVIEW_VERIFICATION_UPDATE_POLICY_BASELINE_DRIFT';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy p
    WHERE p.polrelid = 'storage.objects'::regclass
      AND p.polname = 'review_verifications_owner_delete'
      AND p.polcmd = 'd'
      AND p.polpermissive
      AND p.polroles = ARRAY['authenticated'::regrole::oid]
      AND pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polqual, p.polrelid) =
        '((bucket_id = ''review-verifications''::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = ( SELECT (auth.uid())::text AS uid)))'
  ) OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy p
    WHERE p.polrelid = 'storage.objects'::regclass
      AND p.polname = 'review_verifications_safe_delete'
      AND p.polcmd = 'd'
      AND NOT p.polpermissive
      AND p.polroles = ARRAY['authenticated'::regrole::oid]
      AND pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polqual, p.polrelid) =
        '((bucket_id <> ''review-verifications''::text) OR review_media_delete_allowed(name))'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVIEW_VERIFICATION_DELETE_POLICY_BASELINE_DRIFT';
  END IF;

  SELECT coalesce(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(m) ORDER BY roleid, member, grantor), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO before_members
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m;

  SELECT pg_catalog.to_jsonb(n)
  INTO before_schema
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n
  WHERE n.oid = 'review_media_private'::regnamespace;

  schema_lease := NOT pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(
    workflow_owner,
    'review_media_private',
    'CREATE'
  );
  IF schema_lease THEN
    GRANT CREATE ON SCHEMA review_media_private TO privacy_workflow_owner;
  END IF;

  SELECT pg_catalog.to_jsonb(m)
  INTO self_membership
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m
  WHERE m.roleid = workflow_owner
    AND m.member = runner
    AND m.grantor = runner;

  IF self_membership IS NOT NULL
    AND (self_membership->>'admin_option')::boolean
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVIEW_VERIFICATION_SELF_MEMBERSHIP_DENIED';
  END IF;

  IF pg_major = 17 THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m
      WHERE m.roleid = workflow_owner
        AND m.member = runner
        AND m.admin_option
        AND m.grantor <> runner
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVIEW_VERIFICATION_OWNER_AUTHORITY_MISSING';
    END IF;
    EXECUTE 'GRANT privacy_workflow_owner TO postgres WITH ADMIN FALSE, INHERIT FALSE, SET TRUE GRANTED BY postgres';
  ELSE
    pg15_membership_lease := NOT pg_catalog.pg_has_role(runner, workflow_owner, 'MEMBER');
    IF pg15_membership_lease THEN
      GRANT privacy_workflow_owner TO postgres;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO pg_temp.review_verification_lease(
    pg_major,
    schema_lease,
    pg15_membership_lease,
    self_membership,
    before_members,
    before_schema
  ) VALUES (
    pg_major,
    schema_lease,
    pg15_membership_lease,
    self_membership,
    before_members,
    before_schema
  );
END;
$prepare$;

SET LOCAL ROLE privacy_workflow_owner;
CREATE FUNCTION review_media_private.reject_verification_object_update()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP <> 'UPDATE'
    OR TG_TABLE_SCHEMA <> 'storage'
    OR TG_TABLE_NAME <> 'objects'
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVIEW_VERIFICATION_TRIGGER_CONTEXT_INVALID';
  END IF;

  IF OLD.bucket_id = 'review-verifications'
    OR NEW.bucket_id = 'review-verifications'
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      MESSAGE = 'REVIEW_VERIFICATION_OBJECT_IMMUTABLE',
      ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION review_media_private.reject_verification_object_update()
  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role, supabase_storage_admin;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION review_media_private.reject_verification_object_update()
  TO postgres;

CREATE FUNCTION review_media_private.guard_verification_object_delete()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  object_owner uuid;
  object_review uuid;
  conflicting_tombstone boolean;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP <> 'DELETE'
    OR TG_TABLE_SCHEMA <> 'storage'
    OR TG_TABLE_NAME <> 'objects'
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVIEW_VERIFICATION_DELETE_TRIGGER_CONTEXT_INVALID';
  END IF;

  IF OLD.bucket_id <> 'review-verifications' THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  -- The review INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE statement trigger and the authenticated
  -- delete policy use this same transaction lock. Both race orders therefore
  -- finish with either a live reference plus object, or a retired object key
  -- that review_media_private.guard_references() refuses to reattach.
  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(741093, 1);

  IF review_media_private.referenced(OLD.name) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      MESSAGE = 'REVIEW_VERIFICATION_OBJECT_REFERENCED',
      ERRCODE = '23503';
  END IF;

  BEGIN
    object_owner := pg_catalog.split_part(OLD.name, '/', 1)::uuid;
    object_review := pg_catalog.split_part(OLD.name, '/', 3)::uuid;
  EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      MESSAGE = 'REVIEW_VERIFICATION_OBJECT_DELETE_UNBOUND',
      ERRCODE = '23514';
  END;

  IF NOT review_media_private.canonical(
    OLD.name,
    object_owner,
    object_review,
    'verification'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      MESSAGE = 'REVIEW_VERIFICATION_OBJECT_DELETE_UNBOUND',
      ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;

  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM review_media_private.cleanup c
    WHERE c.path = OLD.name
      AND (
        c.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM object_owner
        OR c.review_id IS DISTINCT FROM object_review
        OR c.purpose IS DISTINCT FROM 'verification'
      )
  ) INTO conflicting_tombstone;

  IF conflicting_tombstone THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      MESSAGE = 'REVIEW_VERIFICATION_OBJECT_TOMBSTONE_CONFLICT',
      ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO review_media_private.cleanup(
    path,
    owner_id,
    review_id,
    purpose,
    retired,
    complete
  ) VALUES (
    OLD.name,
    object_owner,
    object_review,
    'verification',
    true,
    false
  )
  ON CONFLICT (path) DO UPDATE
  SET retired = true,
      complete = false;

  RETURN OLD;
END;
$function$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION review_media_private.guard_verification_object_delete()
  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role, supabase_storage_admin;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION review_media_private.guard_verification_object_delete()
  TO postgres;
RESET ROLE;

CREATE POLICY review_verifications_immutable_update
  ON storage.objects
  AS RESTRICTIVE
  FOR UPDATE
  TO authenticated
  USING (bucket_id <> 'review-verifications')
  WITH CHECK (bucket_id <> 'review-verifications');

CREATE TRIGGER a01_review_verification_immutable_update
  BEFORE UPDATE ON storage.objects
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION review_media_private.reject_verification_object_update();

CREATE TRIGGER a01_review_verification_guard_delete
  BEFORE DELETE ON storage.objects
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION review_media_private.guard_verification_object_delete();

SET LOCAL ROLE privacy_workflow_owner;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION review_media_private.reject_verification_object_update()
  FROM postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION review_media_private.guard_verification_object_delete()
  FROM postgres;

      pg_catalog.upper(lease.self_membership->>'inherit_option'),
      pg_catalog.upper(lease.self_membership->>'set_option')

  END IF;

  IF (
    SELECT coalesce(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(m) ORDER BY roleid, member, grantor), '[]'::jsonb)

  END IF;

-- The earlier migrations remain immutable. This replacement tightens only the

    OR session_user <> 'postgres'

    OR pg_catalog.current_setting('transaction_read_only') <> 'off'
    OR capability_oid IS NULL
    OR pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(
      'public.get_feature_runtime_capability(uuid)'
    ) IS NULL
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FEATURE_RUNTIME_STORAGE_FENCE_PREREQUISITE_MISSING';
  END IF;

    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc AS function_row
    WHERE function_row.oid = capability_oid
      AND function_row.proowner = 'postgres'::pg_catalog.regrole
      AND function_row.prosecdef
      AND function_row.proconfig = ARRAY['search_path=""']::text[]
      AND function_row.prokind = 'f'
      AND function_row.provolatile = 's'
      AND NOT function_row.proretset

      AND function_row.prolang = (
        SELECT language.oid
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_language AS language
        WHERE language.lanname = 'plpgsql'
      )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FEATURE_RUNTIME_STORAGE_FENCE_CAPABILITY_DRIFT';
  END IF;

    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger AS trigger_row
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS function_row
      ON function_row.oid = trigger_row.tgfoid
    WHERE trigger_row.tgrelid = 'storage.objects'::pg_catalog.regclass
      AND trigger_row.tgname = 'a01_review_verification_immutable_update'
      AND trigger_row.tgenabled = 'O'
      AND NOT trigger_row.tgisinternal
      AND trigger_row.tgtype = 19
      AND function_row.oid =
        'review_media_private.reject_verification_object_update()'::pg_catalog.regprocedure
      AND pg_catalog.encode(
        pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(function_row.prosrc, 'UTF8')),
        'hex'
      ) = 'aa1d4951b8d5fdd15249b090c6d6efba897f39eaceee86bf09221eb1d942d545'
  ) OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger AS trigger_row
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS function_row
      ON function_row.oid = trigger_row.tgfoid
    WHERE trigger_row.tgrelid = 'storage.objects'::pg_catalog.regclass
      AND trigger_row.tgname = 'a01_review_verification_guard_delete'
      AND trigger_row.tgenabled = 'O'
      AND NOT trigger_row.tgisinternal
      AND trigger_row.tgtype = 11
      AND function_row.oid =
        'review_media_private.guard_verification_object_delete()'::pg_catalog.regprocedure
      AND pg_catalog.encode(
        pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(function_row.prosrc, 'UTF8')),
        'hex'
      ) = '24311fc7071597fbc78c4c54897690da5aaa70edb62c24f7912fd23fecf515b0'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FEATURE_RUNTIME_STORAGE_FENCE_SOURCE_DRIFT';
  END IF;
END;
$prerequisites$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ocr_private.get_feature_runtime_capability(p_user_id uuid)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_ready boolean;
  v_contracts_ready boolean;
  v_review_ocr_columns_ready boolean;
  v_review_ocr_indexes_ready boolean;
  v_trigger_helper_oid oid := pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(
    'ocr_private.register_review_ocr_generation()'
  );
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM auth.users AS user_row WHERE user_row.id = p_user_id
  ) THEN
    RETURN pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'schema_version', 1,
      'status', 'held',
      'code', 'FEATURE_DATABASE_HELD',
      'capability_version', 'review-media-feature-v1'
    );
  END IF;

  SELECT NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM (
      VALUES
        ('public.claim_receipt_ocr_result(uuid,text,text,text,jsonb,uuid,text,text,text,uuid,boolean)', 'jsonb'::pg_catalog.regtype, false, 'v'::"char"),
        ('public.mark_receipt_ocr_dispatched(uuid,uuid)', 'jsonb'::pg_catalog.regtype, false, 'v'::"char"),
        ('public.complete_receipt_ocr_result(uuid,uuid,jsonb)', 'jsonb'::pg_catalog.regtype, false, 'v'::"char"),
        ('public.mark_receipt_ocr_result_indeterminate(uuid,uuid)', 'jsonb'::pg_catalog.regtype, false, 'v'::"char"),
        ('public.release_receipt_ocr_claim(uuid,uuid)', 'jsonb'::pg_catalog.regtype, false, 'v'::"char"),
        ('public.read_receipt_ocr_result(uuid,text,text,text,jsonb,uuid,text,text,text)', 'jsonb'::pg_catalog.regtype, false, 's'::"char"),
        ('public.get_review_receipt_ocr_generation(uuid,uuid)', 'jsonb'::pg_catalog.regtype, false, 's'::"char"),
        ('public.publish_review_receipt_ocr_result(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,text,jsonb,boolean)', 'jsonb'::pg_catalog.regtype, false, 'v'::"char"),
        ('public.get_feature_runtime_capability(uuid)', 'jsonb'::pg_catalog.regtype, false, 's'::"char"),
        ('public.get_owned_review_storage_objects(uuid,uuid,text,text[])', 'record'::pg_catalog.regtype, true, 'v'::"char"),
        ('public.create_review_with_receipt_ocr(uuid,uuid,uuid,text,text,timestamptz,text,text[],text[],uuid,uuid,uuid,text,timestamptz,text,jsonb)', 'uuid'::pg_catalog.regtype, false, 'v'::"char")
    ) AS required(signature, return_type, returns_set, volatility)
    LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS procedure_row
      ON procedure_row.oid = pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(required.signature)
    WHERE procedure_row.oid IS NULL
      OR procedure_row.proowner <> 'privacy_workflow_owner'::pg_catalog.regrole
      OR NOT procedure_row.prosecdef
      OR procedure_row.proconfig IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['search_path=""']::text[]
      OR procedure_row.prokind <> 'f'
      OR procedure_row.provolatile <> required.volatility
      OR procedure_row.prorettype <> required.return_type
      OR procedure_row.proretset IS DISTINCT FROM required.returns_set
      OR procedure_row.prolang <> (
        SELECT language.oid
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_language AS language
        WHERE language.lanname = 'sql'
      )
      OR NOT pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('service_role', procedure_row.oid, 'EXECUTE')
      OR pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('anon', procedure_row.oid, 'EXECUTE')
      OR pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('authenticated', procedure_row.oid, 'EXECUTE')
  ) INTO v_contracts_ready;

  -- Keep the runtime decision tied to the same exact review-column contract
  -- that the migration and successor controller admit. A later same-name
  -- column with a different type, default, nullability, identity or generated
  -- shape must put the feature back on hold.
  SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) = 4
    AND pg_catalog.bool_and(
      NOT attribute.attnotnull
      AND attribute.atttypmod = -1
      AND attribute.attidentity = ''
      AND attribute.attgenerated = ''
      AND CASE attribute.attname
        WHEN 'receipt_hash' THEN
          attribute.atttypid = 'text'::pg_catalog.regtype
          AND default_value.oid IS NULL
        WHEN 'receipt_data' THEN
          attribute.atttypid = 'jsonb'::pg_catalog.regtype
          AND default_value.oid IS NULL
        WHEN 'is_duplicate' THEN
          attribute.atttypid = 'boolean'::pg_catalog.regtype
          AND pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(
            default_value.adbin,
            default_value.adrelid
          ) = 'false'
        WHEN 'ocr_processed_at' THEN
          attribute.atttypid = 'timestamp with time zone'::pg_catalog.regtype
          AND default_value.oid IS NULL
        ELSE false
      END
    )
  INTO v_review_ocr_columns_ready
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS attribute
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef AS default_value
    ON default_value.adrelid = attribute.attrelid
   AND default_value.adnum = attribute.attnum
  WHERE attribute.attrelid = 'public.reviews'::regclass
    AND attribute.attnum > 0
    AND NOT attribute.attisdropped
    AND attribute.attname = ANY (ARRAY[
      'receipt_hash',
      'receipt_data',
      'is_duplicate',
      'ocr_processed_at'
    ]::name[]);

  -- Index identity is not enough: method, key, predicate and online-validity
  -- flags are all part of the runtime contract.
  SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) = 3
    AND pg_catalog.bool_and(
      index_relation.relkind = 'i'
      AND index_row.indrelid = 'public.reviews'::regclass
      AND access_method.amname = 'btree'
      AND index_row.indnkeyatts = 1
      AND index_row.indnatts = 1
      AND index_row.indexprs IS NULL
      AND index_row.indisvalid
      AND index_row.indisready
      AND index_row.indislive
      AND NOT index_row.indisprimary
      AND NOT index_row.indisexclusion
      AND CASE index_relation.relname
        WHEN 'idx_reviews_receipt_hash' THEN
          index_row.indisunique
          AND pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(index_relation.oid, 1, true) = 'receipt_hash'
          AND pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(
            index_row.indpred,
            index_row.indrelid
          ) = '(receipt_hash IS NOT NULL)'
        WHEN 'reviews_ocr_pending_idx' THEN
          NOT index_row.indisunique
          AND pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(index_relation.oid, 1, true) = 'ocr_processed_at'
          AND pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(
            index_row.indpred,
            index_row.indrelid
          ) = '(verification_photo IS NOT NULL)'
        WHEN 'reviews_duplicate_idx' THEN
          NOT index_row.indisunique
          AND pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(index_relation.oid, 1, true) = 'is_duplicate'
          AND index_row.indpred IS NULL
        ELSE false
      END
    )
  INTO v_review_ocr_indexes_ready
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS index_relation
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS namespace
    ON namespace.oid = index_relation.relnamespace
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index AS index_row
    ON index_row.indexrelid = index_relation.oid
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am AS access_method
    ON access_method.oid = index_relation.relam
  WHERE namespace.nspname = 'public'
    AND index_relation.relname = ANY (ARRAY[
      'idx_reviews_receipt_hash',
      'reviews_ocr_pending_idx',
      'reviews_duplicate_idx'
    ]::name[]);

  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM ocr_private.feature_runtime_capability AS capability
    WHERE capability.capability_version = 'review-media-feature-v1'
      AND capability.schema_version = 1
  )
  AND v_contracts_ready
  AND coalesce(v_review_ocr_columns_ready, false)
  AND coalesce(v_review_ocr_indexes_ready, false)
  AND pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('public.storyboard_production_admin(uuid,text,uuid,integer,jsonb)') IS NOT NULL
  AND pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('public.storyboard_production_worker(uuid,text,uuid,uuid,jsonb)') IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS table_row
    WHERE table_row.oid = 'ocr_private.receipt_results'::pg_catalog.regclass
      AND table_row.relowner = 'postgres'::pg_catalog.regrole
      AND table_row.relrowsecurity
      AND table_row.relforcerowsecurity
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS table_row
    WHERE table_row.oid = 'ocr_private.review_generations'::pg_catalog.regclass
      AND table_row.relowner = 'postgres'::pg_catalog.regrole
      AND table_row.relrowsecurity
      AND table_row.relforcerowsecurity
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc AS helper
    WHERE helper.oid = v_trigger_helper_oid
      AND helper.proowner = 'postgres'::pg_catalog.regrole
      AND helper.prosecdef
      AND helper.proconfig = ARRAY['search_path=""']::text[]
      AND helper.prorettype = 'trigger'::pg_catalog.regtype
      AND helper.prolang = (
        SELECT language.oid
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_language AS language
        WHERE language.lanname = 'plpgsql'
      )
      AND NOT pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('anon', helper.oid, 'EXECUTE')
      AND NOT pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('authenticated', helper.oid, 'EXECUTE')
      AND NOT pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('service_role', helper.oid, 'EXECUTE')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger AS trigger_row
    WHERE trigger_row.tgrelid = 'public.reviews'::pg_catalog.regclass
      AND trigger_row.tgfoid = v_trigger_helper_oid
      AND trigger_row.tgname IN (
        'review_ocr_generation_on_insert',
        'review_ocr_generation_on_reset'
      )
      AND NOT trigger_row.tgisinternal
    GROUP BY trigger_row.tgfoid
    HAVING pg_catalog.count(*) = 2
  )
  -- The metadata fence is operational only while both installed triggers and
  -- their implementation functions retain the exact audited contract. A
  -- disabled, retargeted, redefined or newly exposed helper holds the feature.
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger AS trigger_row
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS function_row
      ON function_row.oid = trigger_row.tgfoid
    WHERE trigger_row.tgrelid = 'storage.objects'::pg_catalog.regclass
      AND trigger_row.tgname = 'a01_review_verification_immutable_update'
      AND trigger_row.tgenabled = 'O'
      AND NOT trigger_row.tgisinternal
      AND trigger_row.tgtype = 19
      AND pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(trigger_row.oid, false) =
        'CREATE TRIGGER a01_review_verification_immutable_update BEFORE UPDATE ON storage.objects FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION review_media_private.reject_verification_object_update()'
      AND function_row.oid =
        'review_media_private.reject_verification_object_update()'::pg_catalog.regprocedure
      AND NOT function_row.prosecdef
      AND function_row.proowner = 'privacy_workflow_owner'::pg_catalog.regrole
      AND function_row.proconfig = ARRAY['search_path=""']::text[]
      AND function_row.prokind = 'f'
      AND function_row.provolatile = 'v'
      AND NOT function_row.proretset
      AND function_row.prorettype = 'trigger'::pg_catalog.regtype
      AND function_row.prolang = (
        SELECT language.oid
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_language AS language
        WHERE language.lanname = 'plpgsql'
      )
      AND pg_catalog.encode(
        pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(function_row.prosrc, 'UTF8')),
        'hex'
      ) = 'aa1d4951b8d5fdd15249b090c6d6efba897f39eaceee86bf09221eb1d942d545'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM pg_catalog.unnest(ARRAY[
          'anon',
          'authenticated',
          'service_role',
          'supabase_storage_admin',
          'postgres'
        ]) AS role_name
        WHERE pg_catalog.has_function_privilege(
          role_name,
          function_row.oid,
          'EXECUTE'
        )
      )
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger AS trigger_row
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS function_row
      ON function_row.oid = trigger_row.tgfoid
    WHERE trigger_row.tgrelid = 'storage.objects'::pg_catalog.regclass
      AND trigger_row.tgname = 'a01_review_verification_guard_delete'
      AND trigger_row.tgenabled = 'O'
      AND NOT trigger_row.tgisinternal
      AND trigger_row.tgtype = 11
      AND pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(trigger_row.oid, false) =
        'CREATE TRIGGER a01_review_verification_guard_delete BEFORE DELETE ON storage.objects FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION review_media_private.guard_verification_object_delete()'
      AND function_row.oid =
        'review_media_private.guard_verification_object_delete()'::pg_catalog.regprocedure
      AND function_row.prosecdef
      AND function_row.proowner = 'privacy_workflow_owner'::pg_catalog.regrole
      AND function_row.proconfig = ARRAY['search_path=""']::text[]
      AND function_row.prokind = 'f'
      AND function_row.provolatile = 'v'
      AND NOT function_row.proretset
      AND function_row.prorettype = 'trigger'::pg_catalog.regtype
      AND function_row.prolang = (
        SELECT language.oid
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_language AS language
        WHERE language.lanname = 'plpgsql'
      )
      AND pg_catalog.encode(
        pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(function_row.prosrc, 'UTF8')),
        'hex'
      ) = '24311fc7071597fbc78c4c54897690da5aaa70edb62c24f7912fd23fecf515b0'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM pg_catalog.unnest(ARRAY[
          'anon',
          'authenticated',
          'service_role',
          'supabase_storage_admin',
          'postgres'
        ]) AS role_name
        WHERE pg_catalog.has_function_privilege(
          role_name,
          function_row.oid,
          'EXECUTE'
        )
      )
  )
  INTO v_ready;

  RETURN pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'schema_version', 1,
    'status', CASE WHEN v_ready THEN 'ready' ELSE 'held' END,
    'code', CASE WHEN v_ready THEN 'FEATURE_DATABASE_READY' ELSE 'FEATURE_DATABASE_HELD' END,
    'capability_version', 'review-media-feature-v1'
  );
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION ocr_private.get_feature_runtime_capability(uuid)
  OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION ocr_private.get_feature_runtime_capability(uuid)
  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION ocr_private.get_feature_runtime_capability(uuid)
  TO privacy_workflow_owner;

DO $readback$
DECLARE
  capability_oid oid := pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(
    'ocr_private.get_feature_runtime_capability(uuid)'
  );
  capability_source text;
BEGIN
  SELECT function_row.prosrc
  INTO STRICT capability_source
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc AS function_row
  WHERE function_row.oid = capability_oid
    AND function_row.proowner = 'postgres'::pg_catalog.regrole
    AND function_row.prosecdef
    AND function_row.proconfig = ARRAY['search_path=""']::text[]
    AND function_row.prokind = 'f'
    AND function_row.provolatile = 's'
    AND NOT function_row.proretset
    AND function_row.prorettype = 'jsonb'::pg_catalog.regtype
    AND function_row.prolang = (
      SELECT language.oid
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_language AS language
      WHERE language.lanname = 'plpgsql'
    );

  IF pg_catalog.strpos(
      capability_source,
      'a01_review_verification_guard_delete'
    ) = 0
    OR pg_catalog.strpos(
      capability_source,
      '24311fc7071597fbc78c4c54897690da5aaa70edb62c24f7912fd23fecf515b0'
    ) = 0
    OR pg_catalog.strpos(
      capability_source,
      'pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(trigger_row.oid, false)'
    ) = 0
    OR NOT pg_catalog.has_function_privilege(
      'privacy_workflow_owner',
      capability_oid,
      'EXECUTE'
    )
    OR pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('anon', capability_oid, 'EXECUTE')
    OR pg_catalog.has_function_privilege(
      'authenticated',
      capability_oid,
      'EXECUTE'
    )
    OR pg_catalog.has_function_privilege(
      'service_role',
      capability_oid,
      'EXECUTE'
    )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FEATURE_RUNTIME_STORAGE_FENCE_READBACK_DRIFT';
  END IF;
END;
$readback$;

COMMIT;

-- Evidence frames and popularity metrics stay off restaurants.evaluation_results
-- and do not change restaurants.updated_at. Delete behavior is undecided, so
-- this migration does not cascade. Hosted apply stays unauthorized.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.restaurant_evidence_frames (
    frame_id text PRIMARY KEY CHECK (char_length(frame_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    content_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK (content_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
    restaurant_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.restaurants (id),
    video_id text NOT NULL,
    timestamp_ms bigint NOT NULL CHECK (timestamp_ms >= 0),
    storage_object_key text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    youtube_seek_url text NOT NULL,
    frame_type text NOT NULL CHECK (frame_type IN ('storefront_sign', 'publisher_location_caption', 'on_site_scene', 'menu_receipt')),
    evidence_level text NOT NULL CHECK (evidence_level IN (
        'SOURCE_OBSERVED',
        'BOUNDARY_INTEGRATION_TESTED',
        'SYNTHETIC_MOCK_TESTED',
        'HOST_TESTED',
        'PROPOSED',
        'UNVERIFIED',
        'CONTRADICTED'
    )),
    confidence_level text NOT NULL CHECK (confidence_level IN ('certain', 'probable', 'uncertain')),
    moderation_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (moderation_status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')),
    detected_shop_name text,
    detected_branch_name text,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.restaurant_popularity_metrics (
    canonical_key text PRIMARY KEY,
    source_revision bigint NOT NULL CHECK (source_revision >= 0),
    scoring_version text NOT NULL,
    cohort_version text NOT NULL,
    popularity_score double precision CHECK (popularity_score IS NULL OR popularity_score = popularity_score),
    popularity_tier text CHECK (popularity_tier IS NULL OR popularity_tier IN ('fire', 'rainbow', 'standard')),
    computed_at timestamptz NOT NULL
);

ALTER TABLE public.restaurant_popularity_metrics ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

    ON public.restaurant_evidence_frames
    FOR SELECT
    USING (moderation_status = 'approved');

#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Source-pinned port of Supabase CLI v2.109.1 parser SplitAndTrim.
 * Upstream commit/path/blob identities are part of this executable contract.
 */
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { readFileSync, statSync } from "node:fs";

export const UPSTREAM_COMMIT = "6d4c19870ed213ba7f682f117d0345c8a40bfa94";
export const UPSTREAM_VERSION = "v2.109.1";
export const TOKEN_PATH = "apps/cli-go/pkg/parser/token.go";
export const TOKEN_BLOB = "db008434246be335b9f7abaf0cb66a99a2b40378";
export const STATE_PATH = "apps/cli-go/pkg/parser/state.go";
export const STATE_BLOB = "47775390d1731c0ad29e10b20fb2fe16c8cfcadb";
const fail = message => { process.stderr.write(`g037 parser: ${message}\n`); process.exit(2); };
const canonical = value => {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(canonical).join(",")}]`;
  if (value && typeof value === "object") return `{${Object.keys(value).sort().map(key => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonical(value[key])}`).join(",")}}`;
  return JSON.stringify(value);
};

/* Exact port of parser.State.Next over the same UTF-8 byte prefixes supplied by
 * tokenizer.ScanToken.  Unsupported invalid UTF-8 and non-default scanner
 * configuration fail closed rather than silently changing Go's byte contract. */
const MAX_SCANNER_CAPACITY = 256 * 1024;
const GO_SPACE = /\p{White_Space}/u;
const IDENTIFIER_RUNE = /[\p{L}\p{Nd}_$]/u;
const TAG_RUNE = /[\p{L}\p{Nd}_]/u;
const trimSpace = value => {
  const runes = Array.from(value); let left = 0, right = runes.length;
  while (left < right && GO_SPACE.test(runes[left])) left++;
  while (right > left && GO_SPACE.test(runes[right - 1])) right--;
  return runes.slice(left, right).join("");
};
const trimRightSpace = value => {
  const runes = Array.from(value); let right = runes.length;
  while (right > 0 && GO_SPACE.test(runes[right - 1])) right--;
  return runes.slice(0, right).join("");
};
const trimRightSemicolons = value => {
  let right = value.length;
  while (right > 0 && value[right - 1] === ";") right--;
  return value.slice(0, right);
};
const equalFold = (bytes, value) => new RegExp(`^${value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&")}$`, "iu").test(bytes.toString("utf8"));
const lastRune = bytes => Array.from(bytes.toString("utf8")).at(-1);
const isBeginAtomic = bytes => {
  const atomic = Buffer.from("ATOMIC");
  let offset = bytes.length - atomic.length;
  if (offset < 0 || !equalFold(bytes.subarray(offset), "ATOMIC")) return false;
  if (offset > 0 && IDENTIFIER_RUNE.test(lastRune(bytes.subarray(0, offset)))) return false;
  const prefix = trimRightSpace(bytes.subarray(0, offset).toString("utf8"));
  offset = Buffer.byteLength(prefix) - 5;
  if (offset < 0 || !equalFold(Buffer.from(prefix, "utf8").subarray(offset), "BEGIN")) return false;
  return offset === 0 || !IDENTIFIER_RUNE.test(lastRune(Buffer.from(prefix, "utf8").subarray(0, offset)));
};
const ready = () => ({ kind: "ready" });
const next = (state, rune, data) => {
  if (state.kind === "ready") {
    if (rune === "$") return { kind: "tag", offset: data.length - Buffer.byteLength(rune) };
    if (rune === "'" || rune === '"') return { kind: "quote", delimiter: rune, escape: false };
    if (rune === "-") return { kind: "comment" };
    if (rune === "/") return { kind: "block", depth: 0 };
    if (rune === "\\") return { kind: "escape" };
    if (rune === ";") return null;
    if (rune === "(") return { kind: "atomic", previous: state, delimiter: Buffer.from(")") };
    if ((rune === "c" || rune === "C") && isBeginAtomic(data)) return { kind: "atomic", previous: state, delimiter: Buffer.from("END") };
    return state;
  }
  if (state.kind === "comment") return rune === "-" ? { kind: "dollar", delimiter: Buffer.from("\n") } : next(ready(), rune, data);
  if (state.kind === "block") {
    const window = data.subarray(data.length - 2);
    if (window.equals(Buffer.from("/*"))) { state.depth++; return state; }
    if (state.depth === 0) return next(ready(), rune, data);
    if (window.equals(Buffer.from("*/"))) { state.depth--; if (state.depth === 0) return ready(); }
    return state;
  }
  if (state.kind === "quote") {
    if (state.escape) return rune === state.delimiter ? { ...state, escape: false } : next(ready(), rune, data);
    if (rune === state.delimiter) state.escape = true;
    return state;
  }
  if (state.kind === "dollar") return data.subarray(data.length - state.delimiter.length).equals(state.delimiter) ? ready() : state;
  if (state.kind === "tag") {
    if (rune === "$") return { kind: "dollar", delimiter: Buffer.from(data.subarray(state.offset)) };
    return TAG_RUNE.test(rune) ? state : next(ready(), rune, data);
  }
  if (state.kind === "escape") return ready();
  if (state.kind === "atomic") {
    const current = next(state.previous, rune, data);
    if (current !== null) state.previous = current;
    if (state.previous.kind === "ready" && equalFold(data.subarray(data.length - state.delimiter.length), state.delimiter.toString("ascii"))) return ready();
    return state;
  }
  throw new Error("unknown parser state");
};
export function splitAndTrim(raw) {
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(raw)) raw = Buffer.from(raw, "utf8");
  if (!Buffer.from(raw.toString("utf8"), "utf8").equals(raw)) throw new Error("invalid UTF-8 is unsupported");
  if (process.env.SUPABASE_SCANNER_BUFFER_SIZE) throw new Error("non-default SUPABASE_SCANNER_BUFFER_SIZE is unsupported");
  const statements = []; let start = 0, offset = 0, state = ready();
  while (offset < raw.length) {
    const first = raw[offset]; let width = 1;
    if (first >= 0x80) {
      if ((first & 0xe0) === 0xc0) width = 2;
      else if ((first & 0xf0) === 0xe0) width = 3;
      else if ((first & 0xf8) === 0xf0) width = 4;
    }
    const end = offset + width, rune = raw.subarray(offset, end).toString("utf8");
    state = next(state, rune, raw.subarray(start, end));
    // bufio.Scanner permits a max-sized token only when Split emits it before
    // it requires another buffer growth; an unterminated max-sized token fails.
    if (state !== null && end - start >= MAX_SCANNER_CAPACITY) throw new Error("statement exceeds pinned default scanner capacity");
    if (state === null) {
      const token = trimSpace(trimRightSemicolons(raw.subarray(start, end).toString("utf8")));
      if (token) statements.push(token);
      start = end; state = ready();
    }
    offset = end;
  }
  const tail = trimSpace(trimRightSemicolons(raw.subarray(start).toString("utf8")));
  if (tail) statements.push(tail);
  return statements;
}
function main() {
  const a = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (a.length !== 8 || a[0] !== "--source" || a[2] !== "--version" || a[4] !== "--sha256" || a[6] !== "--size" || !/^\d{14}$/.test(a[3]) || !new RegExp(`^${a[3]}_[A-Za-z0-9_]+\\.sql$`).test(a[1].replace(/^.*[\\/]/, "")) || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(a[5]) || !/^\d+$/.test(a[7])) fail("expected pinned source identity");
  let raw, size;
  try { raw = readFileSync(a[1]); size = statSync(a[1]).size; } catch { fail("source unreadable"); }
  if (size !== Number(a[7]) || createHash("sha256").update(raw).digest("hex") !== a[5]) fail("source size/hash mismatch");
  let statements; try { statements = splitAndTrim(raw); } catch { fail("unsupported parser input"); }
  if (!statements.length) fail("empty migration vector");
  process.stdout.write(canonical({ schema:"g037-supabase-statement-vector-v1", upstream:{commit:UPSTREAM_COMMIT,version:UPSTREAM_VERSION,token:{path:TOKEN_PATH,blob:TOKEN_BLOB},state:{path:STATE_PATH,blob:STATE_BLOB}}, version:a[3], source_sha256:a[5], source_size:size, statements }) + "\n");
}

import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const repoRoot = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../', import.meta.url));
const pendingReleases = new Set();
const ACQUIRE_REJECTED_EXIT_CODE = 20;
const BUDGET_TARGET_ENV_KEYS = Object.freeze([
    'GEMINI_BUDGET_PATH', 'TZUDONG_PROVIDER_STATE_DIR', 'GEMINI_BUDGET_PROJECT',
    'GEMINI_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE', 'GEMINI_MAX_INFLIGHT',
    'HOME', 'USERPROFILE', 'HOMEDRIVE', 'HOMEPATH',
]);

class BudgetCommandFailure {
    constructor(cause, { childStarted, acquireRejected = false }) {
        this.cause = cause;
        this.childStarted = childStarted;
        this.acquireRejected = acquireRejected;
    }
}

function commandCause(error) {
    return error instanceof BudgetCommandFailure ? error.cause : error;
}

function budgetTargetEnvironment(env) {
    const target = {};
    for (const key of BUDGET_TARGET_ENV_KEYS) {
        if (Object.hasOwn(env, key)) target[key] = env[key];
    }
    return target;
}

function releaseEnvironment(debt, runnerEnv) {
    const env = { ...runnerEnv };
    for (const key of BUDGET_TARGET_ENV_KEYS) delete env[key];
    return Object.assign(env, debt.budgetEnv);
}

function validateBudgetEnvironment(env) {
    const scope = env.GEMINI_BUDGET_PROJECT ?? 'configured-project';
    if (typeof scope !== 'string' || !/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$/.test(scope))
        throw new Error('PROVIDER_BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE');
    for (const [key, fallback, ceiling] of [
        ['GEMINI_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE', 30, 100000],
        ['GEMINI_MAX_INFLIGHT', 1, 8],
    ]) {
        const value = env[key] === undefined ? fallback : Number(env[key]);
        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 1 || value > ceiling)
            throw new Error('PROVIDER_BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE');
    }
}

function budgetCommand(args, env = process.env, { signal } = {}) {
    signal?.throwIfAborted();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const customRunner = Boolean(env.RUN_DAILY_PYTHON);
        const child = spawn(env.RUN_DAILY_PYTHON || 'python3',
            ['-m', 'backend.utils.provider_budget', ...args],
            { cwd: repoRoot, env, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'ignore'] });
        let result = '';
        let settled = false;
        let aborted = false;
        let childStarted = false;
        let forceKill;
        const abortError = () => signal?.reason ?? new DOMException('Provider budget acquisition cancelled', 'AbortError');
        const finish = (error, value) => {
            if (settled) return;
            settled = true;
            clearTimeout(forceKill);
            signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
            if (error) reject(error); else resolve(value);
        };
        const abort = () => {
            if (settled || aborted) return;
            aborted = true;
            child.kill('SIGTERM');
            forceKill = setTimeout(() => child.kill('SIGKILL'), 250);
            forceKill.unref?.();
        };
        child.once('spawn', () => { childStarted = true; });
        child.stdout.on('data', chunk => {
            const remaining = 128 - result.length;
            if (remaining > 0) result += chunk.toString('utf8').slice(0, remaining);
        });
        child.once('error', (cause) => {
            const error = aborted
                ? abortError()
                : new Error('PROVIDER_BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE', { cause });
            finish(new BudgetCommandFailure(error, { childStarted }));
        });
        child.once('close', code => {
            if (aborted) return finish(new BudgetCommandFailure(abortError(), { childStarted }));
            if (code === 0) return finish(undefined, result.trim());
            const error = new Error('PROVIDER_BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE');
            // Only the canonical module's explicit pre-commit exit is definite.
            // Custom runners cannot suppress cleanup by imitating transport text
            // or the numeric protocol code.
            const acquireRejected = args[0] === 'acquire' && !customRunner
                && code === ACQUIRE_REJECTED_EXIT_CODE && result.length === 0;
            finish(new BudgetCommandFailure(error, { childStarted, acquireRejected }));
        });
        signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
        if (signal?.aborted) abort();
    });
}

export function retryAfterSeconds(error) {
    const headers = error?.response?.headers || error?.headers;
    const raw = typeof headers?.get === 'function' ? headers.get('retry-after') : headers?.['retry-after'];
    if (!raw) return null;
    const number = Number(raw);
    const seconds = Number.isFinite(number) ? number : (Date.parse(raw) - Date.now()) / 1000;
    return Number.isFinite(seconds) ? Math.max(0, seconds) : null;
}

export async function applyProjectCooldown(error, env = process.env) {
    const delay = retryAfterSeconds(error);
    if (delay !== null) {
        try { await budgetCommand(['cooldown', '--delay', String(delay)], env); }
        catch (failure) { throw commandCause(failure); }
    }
}

async function releasePermit(debt, runnerEnv) {
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
        try {
            await budgetCommand(
                ['release', '--lease', debt.lease],
                releaseEnvironment(debt, runnerEnv),
            );
            pendingReleases.delete(debt);
            return true;
        } catch {
            if (attempt < 2) await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 25 * (attempt + 1)));
        }
    }
    pendingReleases.add(debt);
    return false;
}

/**
 * @template T
 * @param {() => Promise<T>} work
 * @param {{ acquireTimeoutMs?: number, env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv, signal?: AbortSignal }} [options]
 * @returns {Promise<T>}
 */
export async function withProjectBudget(work, { acquireTimeoutMs = 600000, env: requestedEnv, signal } = {}) {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(acquireTimeoutMs) || acquireTimeoutMs < 1 || acquireTimeoutMs > 600000)
        throw new Error('PROVIDER_BUDGET_INVALID');
    const env = { ...(requestedEnv ?? process.env) };
    validateBudgetEnvironment(env);
    signal?.throwIfAborted();
    // Retry old lease identities with the current healthy runner while keeping
    // the exact budget path/project identity from their acquisition.
    for (const debt of [...pendingReleases]) await releasePermit(debt, env);
    if (pendingReleases.size) throw new Error('PROVIDER_BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE');
    // The parent chooses the identity so an abort racing with a committed child
    // can still release the exact lease after that child has exited.
    const lease = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    const debt = { lease, budgetEnv: budgetTargetEnvironment(env) };
    let acquireMayHaveCommitted = false;
    try {
        const acquired = await budgetCommand([
            'acquire', '--pid', String(process.pid), '--timeout', String(acquireTimeoutMs / 1000), '--lease', lease,
        ], env, { signal });
        acquireMayHaveCommitted = true;
        if (acquired !== lease) throw new Error('PROVIDER_BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE');
        signal?.throwIfAborted();
    } catch (failure) {
        const commandFailure = failure instanceof BudgetCommandFailure ? failure : null;
        const cleanupRequired = commandFailure
            ? commandFailure.childStarted === true && commandFailure.acquireRejected !== true
            : acquireMayHaveCommitted;
        if (cleanupRequired && !await releasePermit(debt, env)) {
            process.stderr.write('warning=PROVIDER_BUDGET_RELEASE_UNAVAILABLE\n');
        }
        throw commandCause(failure);
    }
    try { return await work(); }
    catch (error) {
        try { await applyProjectCooldown(error, env); }
        catch { process.stderr.write('warning=PROVIDER_BUDGET_COOLDOWN_UNAVAILABLE\n'); }
        throw error;
    } finally {
        // A bookkeeping failure cannot discard a settled paid response or
        // replace the provider's original error with a retryable local error.
        if (!await releasePermit(debt, env)) process.stderr.write('warning=PROVIDER_BUDGET_RELEASE_UNAVAILABLE\n');
    }
}

"""Local cross-process project pacing. No keys, prompts, or responses on disk."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from contextlib import contextmanager
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sqlite3
import sys
import time
import uuid


ACQUIRE_REJECTED_EXIT = 20
ACQUIRE_AMBIGUOUS_EXIT = 21


class AcquireOutcomeUnknown(Exception):
    """The lease commit may have succeeded and must be released by identity."""


def positive_int(value: str | None, default: int, ceiling: int) -> int:
    try:
        parsed = int(value or default)
    except ValueError:
        raise ValueError("provider_budget_invalid") from None
    if not 0 < parsed <= ceiling:
        raise ValueError("provider_budget_invalid")
    return parsed


def budget_path() -> Path:
    """A host-wide default prevents separate checkouts multiplying one quota."""
    explicit = os.getenv('GEMINI_BUDGET_PATH')
    if explicit:
        return Path(explicit)
    directory = Path(os.getenv('TZUDONG_PROVIDER_STATE_DIR', str(Path.home()/'.cache'/'tzudong')))
    return directory/'provider-budget.sqlite'


def process_birth(pid: int) -> tuple[str, float, float] | None:
    """Kernel birth identity, epoch start and timestamp uncertainty; no shell/ps parsing."""
    if type(pid) is not int or pid <= 0:
        return None
    try:
        if sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
            # Field 22 follows a parenthesized comm which may contain spaces/').
            fields = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/stat").read_text().rsplit(")", 1)[1].split()
            ticks = int(fields[19])
            boot = Path("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id").read_text().strip()
            boot_epoch = next(int(line.split()[1]) for line in Path("/proc/stat").read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith("btime "))
            if not boot or ticks < 0:
                return None
            # btime is integral seconds, unlike the exact identity's tick count.
            return f"linux:{boot}:{ticks}", boot_epoch + ticks / os.sysconf("SC_CLK_TCK"), 1.0
        if sys.platform == "darwin":
            import ctypes
            import struct
            # Apple's proc_bsdinfo: 12 uint32, 16/32-byte names, 6 uint32,
            # then uint64 pbi_start_tvsec/pbi_start_tvusec (PROC_PIDTBSDINFO=3).
            buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(136)
            proc = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/lib/libproc.dylib").proc_pidinfo
            proc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_uint64, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int]
            proc.restype = ctypes.c_int
            if proc(pid, 3, 0, buffer, len(buffer)) != len(buffer):
                return None
            owner = struct.unpack_from("=I", buffer.raw, 12)[0]
            seconds, micros = struct.unpack_from("=QQ", buffer.raw, 120)
            if owner != pid or seconds <= 0 or micros >= 1_000_000:
                return None
            return f"darwin:{seconds}:{micros}", seconds + micros / 1_000_000, 0.000001
    except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError, StopIteration):
        return None
    return None


class ProjectBudget:
    def __init__(self, path: Path, scope: str, *, rpm: int = 30, concurrency: int = 1):
        import re
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,62}', scope):
            raise ValueError("provider_scope_invalid")
        if not 0 < rpm <= 100000 or not 0 < concurrency <= 8:
            raise ValueError("provider_budget_invalid")
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.path, self.scope = path, scope
        self.interval, self.concurrency = 60 / rpm, concurrency
        with self.connect() as db:
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pacing(scope TEXT PRIMARY KEY, next REAL NOT NULL)")
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leases(scope TEXT, id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, pid INTEGER, started REAL)")
            # Keep the original four-column table compatible with older clients.
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lease_births(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, birth TEXT NOT NULL)")

    @contextmanager
    def connect(self):
        db = sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=30, isolation_level=None)
        try:
            yield db
        finally:
            db.close()

    @staticmethod
    def alive(pid: int) -> bool:
        try:
            os.kill(pid, 0)
            return True
        except ProcessLookupError:
            return False
        except PermissionError:
            return True

    def acquire(self, pid: int, *, timeout: float = 600, identity: str | None = None) -> str:
        owner_birth = process_birth(pid)
        if owner_birth is None:
            raise ValueError("provider_process_identity_unavailable")
        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
        identity = identity or uuid.uuid4().hex
        if re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{32}", identity) is None:
            raise ValueError("provider_lease_invalid")
        while True:
            wait = 0.1
            lease_commit_attempted = False
            try:
                with self.connect() as db:
                    db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
                    now = time.time()
                    for lease, owner, started, stored_birth in db.execute(
                        "SELECT leases.id,pid,started,birth FROM leases LEFT JOIN lease_births ON leases.id=lease_births.id WHERE scope=?", (self.scope,)
                    ).fetchall():
                        alive = self.alive(owner)
                        observed = process_birth(owner) if alive else None
                        stale = not alive
                        if observed is not None:
                            stale = (stored_birth is not None and stored_birth != observed[0]) or (
                                stored_birth is None and isinstance(started, (int, float)) and observed[1] > started + observed[2])
                            # Backfill only a positively older process, never an ambiguous
                            # legacy row. Unknown birth state keeps capacity reserved.
                            if not stale and stored_birth is None and isinstance(started, (int, float)) and observed[1] < started - observed[2]:
                                db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO lease_births VALUES(?,?)", (lease, observed[0]))
                        if stale:
                            db.execute("DELETE FROM leases WHERE id=?", (lease,))
                            db.execute("DELETE FROM lease_births WHERE id=?", (lease,))
                    db.execute("DELETE FROM lease_births WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM leases WHERE leases.id=lease_births.id)")
                    count = db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM leases WHERE scope=?", (self.scope,)).fetchone()[0]
                    row = db.execute("SELECT next FROM pacing WHERE scope=?", (self.scope,)).fetchone()
                    ready = row[0] if row else 0
                    if count < self.concurrency and ready <= now:
                        current_birth = process_birth(pid)
                        if current_birth is None or current_birth[0] != owner_birth[0]:
                            raise ValueError("provider_process_identity_changed")
                        db.execute("INSERT INTO leases VALUES(?,?,?,?)", (self.scope, identity, pid, now))
                        db.execute("INSERT INTO lease_births VALUES(?,?)", (identity, owner_birth[0]))
                        db.execute("INSERT INTO pacing VALUES(?,?) ON CONFLICT(scope) DO UPDATE SET next=excluded.next", (self.scope, now + self.interval))
                        lease_commit_attempted = True
                        db.commit()
                        return identity
                    wait = min(1.0, max(0.01, ready - now)) if ready > now else 0.1
                    db.commit()
            except (OSError, sqlite3.Error) as cause:
                if lease_commit_attempted:
                    raise AcquireOutcomeUnknown("provider_budget_acquire_unknown") from cause
                raise
            if time.monotonic() + wait > deadline:
                raise TimeoutError("provider_budget_timeout")
            time.sleep(wait)

    def release(self, identity: str) -> None:
        with self.connect() as db:
            db.execute("DELETE FROM leases WHERE id=? AND scope=?", (identity, self.scope))
            db.execute("DELETE FROM lease_births WHERE id=? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM leases WHERE id=?)", (identity, identity))

    def cooldown(self, delay: float) -> None:
        import math
        if not math.isfinite(delay) or delay < 0:
            raise ValueError("provider_cooldown_invalid")
        with self.connect() as db:
            db.execute("INSERT INTO pacing VALUES(?,?) ON CONFLICT(scope) DO UPDATE SET next=max(next,excluded.next)", (self.scope, time.time() + delay))

    @contextmanager
    def lease(self):
        identity = self.acquire(os.getpid())
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            self.release(identity)


def _emit_acquired_lease(identity: str, stream) -> int:
    payload = identity + "\n"
    try:
        written = stream.write(payload)
        stream.flush()
    except OSError:
        return ACQUIRE_AMBIGUOUS_EXIT
    return 0 if written is None or written == len(payload) else ACQUIRE_AMBIGUOUS_EXIT


def main(argv=None, stdout=None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("action", choices=("acquire", "release", "cooldown"))
    parser.add_argument("--pid", type=int, default=os.getppid())
    parser.add_argument("--lease", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--delay", type=float, default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=600)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        budget = ProjectBudget(budget_path(),
                               os.getenv("GEMINI_BUDGET_PROJECT", "configured-project"),
                               rpm=positive_int(os.getenv("GEMINI_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE"), 30, 100000),
                               concurrency=positive_int(os.getenv("GEMINI_MAX_INFLIGHT"), 1, 8))
    except (OSError, ValueError, sqlite3.Error):
        if args.action == "acquire":
            return ACQUIRE_REJECTED_EXIT
        raise
    if args.action == "acquire":
        if not 0 < args.timeout <= 600:
            return ACQUIRE_REJECTED_EXIT
        try:
            identity = budget.acquire(args.pid, timeout=args.timeout, identity=args.lease or None)
        except AcquireOutcomeUnknown:
            return ACQUIRE_AMBIGUOUS_EXIT
        except (OSError, ValueError, sqlite3.Error, TimeoutError):
            return ACQUIRE_REJECTED_EXIT
        return _emit_acquired_lease(identity, stdout or sys.stdout)
    elif args.action == "release":
        budget.release(args.lease)
    else:
        budget.cooldown(args.delay)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except (OSError, ValueError, sqlite3.Error, TimeoutError):
        raise SystemExit("PROVIDER_BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE") from None

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';

const pause = ms => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve,ms));
async function leases() {
    const {stdout}=await execute(process.env.RUN_DAILY_PYTHON || 'python3',['-c',
        'import sqlite3,sys; c=sqlite3.connect(sys.argv[1]); print(c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM leases").fetchone()[0]); c.close()',process.env.GEMINI_BUDGET_PATH]);
    return Number(stdout.trim());
}
const responseBody = {candidates:[{content:{role:'model',parts:[{text:'{"ok":true}'}]}}],usageMetadata:{promptTokenCount:3,candidatesTokenCount:5,totalTokenCount:8}};
test('release debt recovers in the same live process before admitting a new provider call', async () => {
    const originalPython=process.env.RUN_DAILY_PYTHON || (await execute('python3',['-c','import sys;print(sys.executable)'])).stdout.trim();
    const wrapper=path.join(directory,'release-wrapper');const flag=path.join(directory,'release-failed');
    const previousPython=process.env.RUN_DAILY_PYTHON,previousFlag=process.env.FX_RELEASE_FAILURE;
    fs.writeFileSync(wrapper,`#!${originalPython}\nimport os,sys,subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\nif 'release' in sys.argv and Path(os.environ['FX_RELEASE_FAILURE']).exists():raise SystemExit(1)\nraise SystemExit(subprocess.run([${JSON.stringify(originalPython)},*sys.argv[1:]],env=os.environ).returncode)\n`,{mode:0o700});
    process.env.RUN_DAILY_PYTHON=wrapper;process.env.FX_RELEASE_FAILURE=flag;
    let calls=0;
    try {
        fs.writeFileSync(flag,'fixture');
        assert.equal(await withProjectBudget(async()=>{calls++;return 'settled';}),'settled');
        assert.equal(await leases(),1);
        await assert.rejects(withProjectBudget(async()=>{calls++;return 'must-not-start';}),/PROVIDER_BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE/);
        assert.equal(calls,1);
        fs.unlinkSync(flag);
        assert.equal(await withProjectBudget(async()=>{calls++;return 'next';},{acquireTimeoutMs:1000}),'next');
        assert.equal(calls,2);assert.equal(await leases(),0);
    } finally {
        if(previousPython===undefined)delete process.env.RUN_DAILY_PYTHON;else process.env.RUN_DAILY_PYTHON=previousPython;
        if(previousFlag===undefined)delete process.env.FX_RELEASE_FAILURE;else process.env.FX_RELEASE_FAILURE=previousFlag;
    }
});
async function removeFixtureLeases(budgetPath) {
    await execute(process.env.RUN_DAILY_PYTHON || 'python3', ['-c',
        'import sqlite3,sys; c=sqlite3.connect(sys.argv[1]); c.execute("DELETE FROM leases"); c.commit(); c.close()', budgetPath]);
}

test('successful result releases the captured acquisition scope even if the caller changes its environment', async () => {
    const originalPath=process.env.GEMINI_BUDGET_PATH;let calls=0;
    const expected={text:'settled-result',usageMetadata:{totalTokenCount:8}};
    try {
        const result=await withProjectBudget(async()=>{
            calls++;process.env.GEMINI_BUDGET_PATH=directory;return expected;
        });
        assert.strictEqual(result,expected);assert.equal(calls,1);
    } finally {
        process.env.GEMINI_BUDGET_PATH=originalPath;
        await removeFixtureLeases(originalPath);
    }
    assert.equal(await leases(),0);
});

test('provider error identity survives caller environment changes during cooldown and release', async () => {
    const originalPath=process.env.GEMINI_BUDGET_PATH;
    const expected=Object.assign(new Error('synthetic-provider-failure'),{headers:{'retry-after':'1'}});
    try {
        await assert.rejects(withProjectBudget(async()=>{
            process.env.GEMINI_BUDGET_PATH=directory;throw expected;
        }),error=>error===expected);
    } finally {
        process.env.GEMINI_BUDGET_PATH=originalPath;
        await removeFixtureLeases(originalPath);
    }
});
async function serverFixture(handler) {
    const server=createServer(handler);
    await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',resolve));
    return {server,baseUrl:`http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`,close:()=>new Promise(resolve=>server.close(resolve))};
}

test('installed SDK default and explicit one-attempt policy each send exactly one HTTP request',async()=>{
    let requests=0;
    const fixture=await serverFixture((_req,res)=>{requests++;res.writeHead(503,{'content-type':'application/json'});res.end('{"error":{"message":"fixture","code":503}}');});
    try {
        for (const httpOptions of [{baseUrl:fixture.baseUrl},{...geminiHttpOptions(1000),baseUrl:fixture.baseUrl}]) {
            const ai=new GoogleGenAI({apiKey:'fixture',httpOptions});
            await assert.rejects(ai.models.generateContent({model:'gemini-3.7-flash',contents:'fixture'}),error=>error.status===503);
        }
        assert.equal(requests,2);
    } finally {await fixture.close();}
});

test('shared client migrates the exact legacy model while preserving prompt and generation settings',async()=>{
    const bodies=[];const routes=[];
    const fixture=await serverFixture(async(req,res)=>{
        let data='';for await(const chunk of req)data+=chunk;
        bodies.push(JSON.parse(data));routes.push(req.url.split('?')[0]);
        res.writeHead(200,{'content-type':'application/json'});res.end(JSON.stringify(responseBody));
    });
    const config=omitUnsupportedGeminiSampling('gemini-3.7-flash',{temperature:.1,maxOutputTokens:8192,responseMimeType:'application/json',thinkingConfig:{thinkingLevel:'MEDIUM'}});
    try {
        const model=new GoogleGenerativeAI('fixture').getGenerativeModel({model:'gemini-3.7-flash',generationConfig:config},{baseUrl:fixture.baseUrl});
        await model.generateContent('fixture');
        const ai=createGeminiClient('fixture');
        const result=await generateWithProjectBudget(ai,{model:'gemini-3.7-flash',contents:'fixture',config:{...config,httpOptions:{baseUrl:fixture.baseUrl}}},1000);
        assert.equal(result.text,'{"ok":true}');
        assert.deepEqual(bodies[0].contents,bodies[1].contents);
        assert.deepEqual(bodies[0].generationConfig,bodies[1].generationConfig);
        assert.equal(routes[0],'/v1beta/models/gemini-3.7-flash:generateContent');
        assert.equal(routes[1],'/v1beta/models/gemini-3.8-flash:generateContent');
        assert.equal(await leases(),0);
    }finally{await fixture.close();}
});

test('deadline aborts but does not release a project permit while the SDK promise remains unsettled',async()=>{
    let settle;let announced;const started=new Promise(resolve=>announced=resolve);
    let signal;let secondStarted=false;
    const first=generateWithProjectBudget({models:{generateContent:request=>{signal=request.config.abortSignal;announced();return new Promise(resolve=>settle=resolve);}}},{model:'gemini-3.7-flash',contents:'fixture'},20);
    const observed=first.then(()=>null,error=>error);
    await started;await pause(30);
    assert.equal(signal.aborted,true);
    const second=generateWithProjectBudget({models:{generateContent:async()=>{secondStarted=true;return {text:'ok'};}}},{model:'gemini-3.7-flash',contents:'fixture'},1000);
    await pause(35);
    try {
        assert.equal(secondStarted,false);assert.equal(await leases(),1);
    }finally{settle({text:'late response'});}
    assert.equal((await observed).code,'GEMINI_API_TIMEOUT');
    assert.equal((await second).text,'ok');assert.equal(await leases(),0);
});

test('SDK HTTP timeout aborts transport, publishes no success and leaves no lease',async()=>{
    let closed=false;
    const fixture=await serverFixture((req,_res)=>req.on('close',()=>{closed=true;}));
    try {
        const ai=createGeminiClient('fixture');
        await assert.rejects(generateWithProjectBudget(ai,{model:'gemini-3.7-flash',contents:'fixture',config:{httpOptions:{baseUrl:fixture.baseUrl}}},40),error=>error.code==='GEMINI_API_TIMEOUT');
        assert.equal(await leases(),0);assert.equal(closed,true);
    }finally{fixture.server.closeAllConnections();await fixture.close();}
});

test('Retry-After from real SDK response headers applies a shared project cooldown',async()=>{
    let requests=0;
    const fixture=await serverFixture((_req,res)=>{
        requests++;res.writeHead(429,{'content-type':'application/json','retry-after':'1'});res.end('{"error":{"message":"fixture","code":429}}');
    });
    try {
        const ai=createGeminiClient('fixture');
        await assert.rejects(generateWithProjectBudget(ai,{model:'gemini-3.7-flash',contents:'fixture',config:{httpOptions:{baseUrl:fixture.baseUrl}}},1000),error=>error.status===429);
        assert.equal(requests,1);
        const start=Date.now();
        await generateWithProjectBudget({models:{generateContent:async()=>({text:'ok'})}},{model:'gemini-3.7-flash',contents:'fixture'},1000);
        assert.ok(Date.now()-start>=800);assert.equal(await leases(),0);
    }finally{await fixture.close();}
});
